This study leverages a state-of-the-art deep learning architecture, EfficientNetB3, to build an efficient and accurate framework for colon cancer detection using histopathological images. By utilizing transfer learning and advanced preprocessing techniques, the model achieves an excellent accuracy of 98.86% with high precision and recall, minimizing false positives and false negatives. The model's robustness and generalization capability are further enhanced by data augmentation and optimization methods, such as Adamax and batch normalization. This research demonstrates that integrating EfficientNet with a scalable and lightweight design performs well in adenocarcinoma detection from normal tissues, thereby holding the promise to serve as a non-invasive and reliable diagnostic tool. Ultimately, deep learning holds great promise for early cancer detection, providing a solid foundation for future developments of AI-driven healthcare solutions.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Retrospective Analysis of Cyberbullying Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Cyberbullying has become one of the main concerns in today's digital world, posing a great risk to everyone being online and effecting their mental health and their online safety. This research explores the application of machine learning using the Machine Learning algorithm to detect and reduce the cyberbullying behaviours. Here we utilize the data from the dataset of cyberbullying done by people online, preprocessing the data to clean and structure it for analysis. Here we use various Machine learning models like Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression and SVM, which are then tested on dataset for accuracy, precision, recall, and overall effectiveness in detecting the harmful words and pattern. Our result highlight that which of the model that we used performed best contributing to detection of Cyberbullying online. Additionally, the research underscores the importance of integrating NPL(Natural Language Processing) for delicate text analysis and sentiment detection. The insights from this research aim to support the development of Machine learning models for monitoring and addressing online harassment, making a safer digital environment.

articleTitle: EfficientNet-Based Cassava Leaf Disease Classification with Advanced Augmentation for Enhanced Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: In this paper, a deep learning approach for detecting cassava diseases from high resolution images is presented. The dataset, sourced from the Cassava Leaf Disease Classification competition on Kaggle, includes five disease categories: Cassava Mosaic Disease, Cassava Brown Streak Disease, Cassava Green Mottle Disease, Bacterial Blight and Healthy leaves. EfficientNetB3 architecture and sophisticated data augmentation (random cropping, flipping, rotation and contrast adjustment) is utilized to increase robustness and generalization. With stratification, the dataset is split into training, validation, and test subsets to guarantee balanced class representation. The model trained for eight epochs and achieved 88.5% validation accuracy, which proves it could be used for disease classification. Performance metrics like precision, recall and F1 score are analyzed, the model shows high performance in classifying healthy leaves. The results of this research demonstrate the ability of AI to support precision agriculture and provide a foundation for scalable cassava disease detection solutions.

articleTitle: AI and its Impact on Learning Patterns, Creative Quotient (CQ) and Emotional Quotient (EQ) of Students: A Correlational Study
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: The contemporary education system is constantly changing and witnessing a significant alteration influenced by the recents developments in the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and metadata. These innovations not only enhance teaching-learning methodologies but also align with global educational paradigms emphasizing personalized, creative, and emotionally intelligent learning. This paper integrates the themes of learning patterns, creative quotient (CQ) and emotional quotient (EQ) as influenced by AI. The rapid evolution of modern-day technology has significantly transformed how students engage with and absorb knowledge. This paper explores the influence of contemporary technological advancements—specifically Artificial Intelligence (AI)—on the learning patterns of students. It also delves into the enhancement of students’ creative quotient (CQ) and emotional quotient (EQ) as a result of technological stimuli and evaluates the role of AI in shaping educational environments. Through a correlational study, this paper investigates the relation between AI and Learning patterns, CQ and EQ amongst the students.

articleTitle: Optimizing Indoor Air Quality with IoT and Sensor-Based Solutions: A Case Study of Office Buildings
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: The stall of indoor air can affect people's health, productivity, and overall well-being. In office buildings through IAQ, health consequences can include the onset of respiratory problems, fatigue, and higher rates of sick leave. Today, publics use a considerable quantity of their stage in these indoor surroundings. Workplaces have seen an increasing demand for IAQ optimization over the years a Case Study Demonstrating How IoT and Sensor-Based Solutions Bring IAQ into Focus in Office Buildings Open Access. MDPI The study took place at a large commercial office building with poor IAQ resulting from improper ventilation and air filtration. The building has a network of air quality sensors that monitor and record various factors, including temperature, humidity, CO2 levels, and particulate matter. The central control system received this data in real time and interpreted it to adjust the building's ventilation and filtration systems. Results of the study confirmed a remarkable enhancement in IAQ, a decrease in CO2 levels, and a reduction in the concentration of particulate matter, followed by an increase in overall air quality. Alternatively, it improved the energy efficiency of the building as HVAC systems could also operate more effectively, saving money for the maintenance of the host building.

articleTitle: Balancing Technology with Pedagogy in Smart Classrooms for English Language
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Background: The sophisticated technology in education have turned conventional classrooms into smart learning environments providing dynamic and interactive aids for language acquisition. In English language instruction, juggling technology with pedagogy offers both possibilities and difficulties. Problem Statement: Rapid acceptance of smart classroom technologies―such as interactive whiteboards, augmented reality (AR), and adaptive learning platforms―has improved participation and customised learning experiences. Empirical data on their instructional effectiveness in supporting language acquisition goals, especially in developing critical language abilities including reading comprehension, writing, speaking, and listening, is lacking, still. This paper fills in this need by looking at how well technology-enhanced pedagogy works in English language acquisition in smart classrooms. Methodology: Using a quasi-experimental approach involving 200 secondary school students split into two groups―a control group taught using conventional techniques and an experimental group employing smart classroom technologies―we found. The study ran for twelve weeks, with pre- and post-tests utilizing standardised assessments gauging degrees of linguistic competency. Findings: With an average score increase of 18% in reading comprehension, 15% in writing skills, 20% in listening skills, and 22% in speaking abilities, results showed a notable rise in the general language competency of the experimental group from the control group. Furthermore, the experimental group's student participation rates―based on surveys―were thirty percent higher. These results imply that English language learning results can be much improved by means of strategic integration with pedagogically sound strategies.

articleTitle: Enhancing Sales Forecasting in E-Commerce Through Advanced Predictive Analytics and Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Within this context, this research is aimed at enhancing the sales forecasting in e-commerce using the newer approaches of predictive analytics and deep neural networks. There usually is significant variability of results as compared to traditional approaches that are based on historical data and simple econometric models. This research evaluates how deep learning approaches, LSTM and Transformer models, improve precisely the forecast by noticing the behaviour dynamics and more complex patterns in the business environment. The actual approach includes sales history data, understanding customers, trends, and related promotions to train as well as test neural networks. The basic hybrid approach integrates deep learning and statistical methods to forecast the maximum potential outcomes. The performance of models in this study is evaluated by Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error(RMSE) and R-Squared to compare the forecasted sales values with the actual ones. It is established that incorporating the deep learning models that have been described enhances the forecast precision concerning the baseline and conventional methods of approach significantly, especially the hybrid model. The precise accuracy, and factors that cause it to fluctuate from one product category to another, and the impact of promotional activities on the forecast's precision, are addressed. Thus, the study contributes to the knowledge that adopting innovative techniques such as advanced predictive analytics and deep learning to improve sales forecasting can potentiate strategic business courses of action and the firm's performance in today's cut-throat e-commerce marketplace.

articleTitle: Empirical Study to Select a Place to Stay in NCR Area Using Data Mining and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: From starting of the human civilization, the peoples are traveling to one place to another place for different kinds of works such as business, tourism etc. and they are need accommodation to stay there. Before the 21st century, there was a limited option to search the places for accommodation. In the digital world there are options are increasingly in comparison with the previous time. Now if someone going for a vacation for a short term, he or she can find a hotel or lodge for the same, but when students migrate one place to another or a person transfer to another city or place than he need to find a suitable place to stay for a long time. In this research paper, we try to find the best solution for this kind of problem. Here we discuss the result with some predetermined parameters. These parameters set and trained on the collected data from different type of people from different geolocations. After it, the collected data is fed to the K-Means algorithm. This algorithm is used for the making the clusters. After it by using REST API, the output of K-Means algorithms is shown on a Map.

articleTitle: Super-Resolution of Satellite Images Using Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN)
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: This paper, a general approach for enhancing the resolution of the satellite images using GANs has been provided. Satellites are used to collect low resolution images, hence are unsuitable for detailed evaluations for applications such as planning of cities, and disaster assessment. Our work adopts the idea of GAN - a model comprising of generator and discriminator, which create images of high resolution from images of low resolution. Here adversarial loss increases the quality of the image, content loss retain important features and details in the image and total variation loss reduces the pixel differences. The performance is compared with other approaches, and it is approximately higher for all method and quality measure rules, such as PSNR, SSIM and FID. This approach offers a worthy approach for enhancing satellite imagery and thus enhancing its usability for most geospatial applications.

articleTitle: IoT and Sensor-Enabled Waste Management: Towards Smart and Sustainable Cities
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: IoT and sensor-based waste management exist as priority solutions for the problems from an urban perspective. Urban areas keep on rising in population, with a developing measure of waste created yearly that can put immense strain on conventional Waste Management Systems. This is where forward-thinking technologies like IoT and sensors are introduced into waste management services to be more resourceful, cost-effective, and eco-friendly. A network of connected devices, sensors, and data analytics to collect real-time data is made possible because of this IoT technology. IoT can be used to check and track bin & container waste levels and disposal routing scheduling needs. It enables information transfer among recycling service providers and residents. This can also include sensors in waste bins that allow real-time data on the composition of discarded materials to be gathered and help spot improvements. IoT and sensor technology in waste management help to reduce costs of waste collection & disposal and more effective sorting of recyclable materials, which can be what we need for a long time while caring about the environment. Moreover, the live data it provides helps make effective and well-planned decisions for waste management strategies in the future. All told, combining IoT with sensor-based waste management stands to revolutionize our great cities into intelligent and sustainable places, instigating better disposal habits conducive to people's health.

articleTitle: Optimizing Wireless Mesh Networks for IoT Using Hybrid Genetic-PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: WMNs are considered as one of the primary enabling technologies for growth and development of IoT systems because of their feature of providing scalable and robust connections in supporting the fast-evolving IoT applications. However, the challenge of efficiently and effectively addressing these issues while enhancing energy efficiency, low latency and high throughput of these network increases as the numbers of connected devices rises. This research work therefore presents a genetic-PSO algorithm for the optimization of WMNs for IoT paradigms. The hybrid of GA and PSO is used to attempt GA capability of exploration with PSO ability to converge when solving multi-objective optimization problems in WMNs; energy, latency and throughput. As a performance comparison metric, we have compared our Hybrid Genetic-PSO algorithm with the original optimization methods for real-world data by the deployment of a smart city IoT and simulated data of NS-3 network simulator. The study shows that the use of the proposed algorithm has a positive effect on energy consumption by cutting it by 20.8%, latency by reducing its by 20.8% and at the same time increasing through put by 28%. Some of these improvements were also tested and confirmed on live networks proving the usefulness of the algorithm in real world application. The Hybrid Genetic-PSO algorithm is a robust optimization technique for WMNs providing assurance that WMNs needs to meet IoT requirements for applications such as real-time control and low-energy data transmission.

articleTitle: Identification of Organisational Citizenship Behavior During Virtual Interview: Risk Management Using AI Based Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: The Organisational Citizenship behavior (OCB) can be predicted during virtual interviews in the selection process, raising concerns about authenticity and risk management. With a well- designed interview platform using deep learning algorithms to assess facial expressions, speech patterns, and physiological reactions in real time the HR Mangers can adapt it. The dataset includes several interview scenarios to train the neural network to adapt to varied settings. Human resource management gains a new way to virtual interview risk reduction from this study. Deep neural networks increase candidate authenticity and reduce deception. The test results demonstrate our approach's ability to recognise real candidate answers. The technology is resistant to deception, making it suitable for virtual interview platforms.

articleTitle: Improving Public Transport Systems Through Big Data Analytics: A Roadmap for Smarter Mobility Solutions
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: The following paper aims to discover the application of big data technology to optimise public transport, particularly in its performance aspects, customers' satisfaction, safety, and eco-friendly nature. Since there is an increase in complexity for mobility in the urban environment, the concepts of managing PTD based on old school approaches pose problem and are unable to address issues of demand, congestion and service irregularities. Based on real-time data from GPS, smart ticketing and passenger feedback system, this research explores a conceptual framework for decision making for enhancing service delivery. The flow comprises data gathering, preparation, and fusion, analytics in the form of prediction, monitoring, sentiment analysis, and machine learning. These tools facilitate real-time route optimization, demand prediction, and customers' satisfaction increases. Results show significant improvements: Lower turnaround time, higher on time performance and satisfaction level among passengers. Sustainability is introduced by a reduction in fuel consumption and emissions by 20%, as well as by the broader provision of hybrid and electrical vehicles. Measures in safety were improved as well reflected by the decrease of incident rates and the increase of response time. These research findings are evident of how big data hold the possibilities to revolutionalise PT systems to be more effective, reliable and centre around the passengers. These findings reveal the advantages of evidence-based management in urban commuting and outline possible further usage of new technologies to enhance transport.

articleTitle: IoT and 5G Integration: Transforming Real-Time Applications in Smart Industries
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Modern M2M communication engaged with IoT and 5G technology is reinventing real time applications in smart industries through provision of efficient connectivity, low latency and large number of devices connection. This synchronizes makes it possible to transform industries, and hence lay down the groundwork for Industry 4.0 and more. The IM connectivity along with increased reliability and velocity made available by 5G technology improve IoT networks; key service use cases include predictive maintenance, robotic control, and real-time information analytics. Through network slicing, the key application areas can be prioritized to get the right of way and optimal resource consumptions in the 5G applications. In addition, the compatibility of IoT systems with high 5G networks resolves the difficulties that arise from various industrial settings, including the coordination of large amounts of data produced by the IoT devices. It also enhances energy use efficiency, decreases operational expenses and fosters sustainability, due to the use of improved resource optimisation. It notes that manufacturing logistics and healthcare key industrial areas have experienced changes through areas such as remote monitoring, digital twins, and augmented reality applications. This paper examines the technological convergence between IoT and 5G, showcases innovative industrial use cases, and advances opportunities and threats of the integration to establish intelligent and efficient sectors in the context of the internet of things.

articleTitle: Automated Serve Shot Classification in Table Tennis Using CNN-LSTM Framework
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Analysis of table tennis serve shot is significant for player strategies and performance. In this work we propose a hybrid deep learning framework based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks that aims to automate serve classification and success prediction. A custom dataset of 10,000 annotated serve shots was used for training and evaluation of the proposed model, which obtained a serve class accuracy of 92.3%, which was much superior to baseline CNN (85.6%) and LSTM (80.2%) models. In addition, the recorded success prediction accuracy was 88.7%, which proved the feasibility that the model can realize to learn to predict effective serves with high precision. For evaluation metrics, the model's precision was 0.91, recall was 0.93, and f1 score was 0.92, validating it to separate among different serve types. The overall performance of the framework in predicting serve success and failure can be confirmed by the area under the ROC curve (AUC) at 0.93. Results from confusion matrix analysis confirmed that the model could classify frequent serve types with greater than 95% accuracy but slight misclassifications occurred with visually similar serve types. As Training and Validation accuracies improve steadily to 92.3% and 91.5% respectively and losses fall from 0.6 to 0.12, measure of learning, the lack of fit is minimal. The results show that the CNN-LSTM framework can be used to provide information to players and coaches, empowering data driven decision making and performance optimization. As future work, the dataset will be extended, the model architecture will be further refined, and realtime analytics will be added for improved practical usefulness in table tennis coaching and strategic development.

articleTitle: Integrating Automation and Sustainability: Arduino-Based Solar Panel Cleaning System for Renewable Energy Optimization
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: This paper realizes the design and implementation of an automatic cleaning system for solar cells through Arduinos, so they can work better and last longer with less maintenance. The system combines an Arduino microcontroller, servo motors, water spray devices, and sensors to automate the cleaning process. This not only eliminates dirt, dust, or debris; it ensures consistent efficacy. Testing showed that output from panels improved significantly after cleaning. Each time only 2.4 liters of water and 0.05 kWh of power were used, for a minimal consumption level. Its modular and inexpensive design makes it suitable for residential and small-scale use. From the optimum interval determined for monthly cleaning, a balance of efficiency gains and cost may be struck. This project forms a practical, not to mention scaleable, and sustainable solution for maintaining solar panels. Use of renewable energy technologies will further reduce the environmental impact. Next-generation developments might incorporate advanced dirt recognition or the convergence of renewable energy integration into their capabilities.

articleTitle: Deepfake Detection in Picture
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: With the growing prevalence of hyper-realistic counterfeit images, particularly Deepfake and Face2Face, accurately identifying manipulated facial expressions has become a critical challenge in digital forensics. Traditional forensic methods often fail due to the substantial degradation of image data during manipulation processes, necessitating novel approaches. This paper introduces two lightweight deep learning networks tailored to effectively detect facial expression anomalies while focusing on mesoscopic image structures. Unlike conventional methods that rely on complex architectures, our proposed networks employ a minimal number of layers to prioritize computational efficiency and structural precision. We evaluate these networks on both established datasets and a newly curated online photo dataset to assess their performance comprehensively. The suggested strategy yields an impressive detection rate of 97% for Deepfake, according to the experimental results and 94% for Face2Face, underscoring its robustness and efficacy. This work contributes a streamlined yet highly effective approach for detecting manipulated facial images, offering promising advancements in combating visual misinformation in digital media.

articleTitle: Enhancing CT-Based Lung Cancer Diagnosis with CNN and LSTM Architecture
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: New case of lung cancer is among the leading causes of cancer related deaths in the world and therefore early detection improves prognosis. In this paper, the author presents a new deep learning model, which combines CNN and LSTM for better lung cancer detection. The CNN component extracts the spatial features out of individual slices of the CT, while the LSTM extracts temporal dependencies over several consecutive slices to let the model take advantage of both spatial and temporal patterns. The proposed CNN-LSTM model can reach 92.1% accuracy on LIDC-IDRI dataset, it significantly outperforms the standalone CNN with 87.0% and LSTM with 85.3%. Indeed, the current model achieved high accuracy (90.2%), recall (91.5%), and F1- score (90.8%), which suggests that it is effective in minimizing the number of false negatives and false positives that are critical in clinical diagnosis. It has a high accuracy in distinguish malignant from benign nodule with the AUC of 0.93 as well. The ablative studies supported the joint operations of the CNN and LSTM, and the application of the integrated architectural design was found to show improved performance. Hyperparameter tuning, with the learning rate at 0.001 and the utilizing of 128 LSTM units, brought improvements to learn statistical models. Grad-CAM graphics enhanced interpretability as focal points on the regions associated with malignancy were enlarged. However, problems like high computation time and requirement of large amounts of labeled data still exist even in such a well-developed model. To the present study, this paper provides a theoretical possibility of early and accurate diagnosis of lung cancer to improve the application of AI in healthcare.

articleTitle: Emotional Intelligence-Enhanced Convlstm-Based Water Wave Optimization for Healthcare Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) and sophisticated optimisation techniques have shown to be revolutionary in the field of healthcare applications, particularly in the domains of data analysis, prediction, and decision-making. Regarding dynamic and sophisticated healthcare data, traditional optimisation methods often provide difficulties. This work investigates in the framework of healthcare the application of Emotional Intelligence (EI) and Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (ConvLSTM) networks inside a Water Wave Optimisation (WWO) algorithm. This work aims to solve the limitations associated with traditional optimisation methods. Medical records and patient monitoring among other things make analysis and prediction of the consequences of data in the healthcare sector difficult due of their often huge, unstructured, dynamic character. The complexity of this data cannot be sufficiently captured by the present optimisation methods, thus solutions derived from them are not ideal for the decision-making process in the healthcare sector. Emotional Intelligence-based Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (ConvLSTM) integrated Water Wave Optimisation (EI-ConvLSTM-WWO) algorithm is presented in this work. By means of the simulation of emotional decision-making, the EI model aids in the optimisation process. This so enhances the convergence and accuracy of the WWO method. Spatiotemporal characteristics of healthcare data are obtained using convolutional long short-term memory.

articleTitle: Qualitative and Quantitative Perspectives on Video Watermarking Approaches
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: The technique of video watermarking performs a critical part in ensuring protection of digital video content by embedding an imperceptible yet detectable mark into the video stream. This paper explores both the qualitative and quantitative aspects of various video watermarking techniques. The study categorizes watermarking methods into spatial domain and frequency domain techniques, providing a comprehensive comparison of their effectiveness regarding visual being imperceptible and resilient to attacks, computational complexity, along with embedding capacity. Important quantitative evaluation measures are provided, such as PSNR(Peak Signal to Noise Ratio), Bit Error Rate(BER), and Structural Similarity Index(SSIM).

articleTitle: Real-Time Language Translation Using IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: This research addresses the challenge of real-time interlinguistic communication with the aid of an IoT-based language translation system. Herein, a Web of Things device-a Raspberry Pi centrality-is brought out to convert and interpret a spoken language into the target dialect. The integration will be done from speech recognition services and translation services onto the hardware elements. Key findings show that the system is able to translate spoken words with 86% accuracy in 30 languages, thereby helping improve intercultural communication and collaboration.

articleTitle: Enhancing Sensitivity and Specificity in Diabetic Retinopathy Detection Using CNN-LSTM Models
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Early and accurate detection of diabetic retinopathy (DR), as the leading cause of blindness worldwide, is important to prevent blindness. We propose a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network and Long Short Term Memory (CNN LSTM) model to increase DR classification through a combination of spatial feature extractions and sequential learning. We illustrate the training and evaluation of the proposed model on the APTOS 2019 and EyePACS datasets of retinal fundus images, each annotated into five severity stages of DR. Experimental results show that the proposed CNN-LSTM model achieves 93.1% accuracy, which is better than ResNet-50 (89.2%), and DenseNet-121 (90.3%) baseline models. Overall, the model had sensitivity of 92.0% vs. 87.5% and 88.9% for ResNet-50 and DenseNet-121 respectively, which proves (that the model) was better at identifying DR cases. Furthermore, the CNN-LSTM model achieved specificity of 92.8%, which leads to a drop in the false positive rate, fairly superior to ResNet_50 (88.6%), DenseNet_121 (89.5%). Using the proposed model displayed superior discriminative power (Area Under the Curve (AUC) score 0.96) compared to ResNet-50 (0.91) and DenseNet-121 (0.93). Finally, we analyzed the performance of the model though training-validations curves, confusion matrix analysis and achieved final training accuracy of 94.5 % and validation accuracy of 93.1% with stable learning but very minimal overfitting. The results presented show the potential of the proposed CNN-LSTM framework in improving DR detection and thus, as a viable tool for use in automated screening. Towards future work, we will study methods to improve generalization with attention mechanisms as well as with larger scale datasets.

articleTitle: Integration of Continuous Improvement Approach in Sustainable E-Government Services Towards Citizen Satisfaction in Health Sector Development of Conceptual Model
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: E-government success relies on high-quality e-services. Understanding e-government service quality is crucial for improving existing and future implementations. As the globe advances in communication and information technology, study on e-government services especially in health sector since covid-19 is gaining momentum. This study introduces a conceptual model for measuring the impact of continuous improvement approach on sustainable e-government services in health sector. The suggested model identifies five stream dimensions to assess the quality of e-government services based on a survey of relevant literature. This article focuses on the five dimension of continuous improvement approach the efficiency, accessibility, and sustainability of e-government services. This research provides a conceptual model for integrating continuous improvement approach to promote sustainable long-term e-government services in the health care area. Governments may use AI-driven analytics, predictive modeling, and automation to improve administrative procedures, personalise healthcare services, and enable data-driven decision-making. The concept of continuous improvement approach is central to the model, in which AI algorithms continuously analyze data from various sources, such as electronic health records, patient feedback and performance metrics. The outcome of the conceptual model is to identify the effect of integrating continuous improvement approach in the healthcare sector to achieve sustainable e-government services that optimizes resource allocation, improves service quality, and fosters innovation for Citizen Satisfaction. This research adds to the literature on e-government and healthcare management by presenting a new conceptual model that combines ideas of continuous improvement. Future study should concentrate on empirical validation and implementation methodologies to determine the suggested model's usefulness and scalability in real-world scenarios. Overall, incorporating continuous improvement methodologies has the potential to advance long-term e-government services in the healthcare sector for benefiting public health.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Techniques for Cyber Bullying Detection in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Cyberbullying detection (CBD) is a technology that is both popular and strong, thus many natural language processing (NLP) experts are intrigued in it. Whereas the latter need considerable and complex engineering, traditional approaches mostly depend on natural language processing (NLP) software developed by a third party and features defined manually. Furthermore, aggravating the situation is the way the several subtasks are used to divide a task into a lot of smaller ones on CBD procedure, which does not follow the usual approach. By using a combination approach depending on Capsule Network (CapsNet) to complete a job, this research is able to bypass these constraints. After feature representations are extracted from input corpora using CapsNet, the next stage is the reconstruction of events from the RNN output using the combination approach. Using several annotated corpora in the case that an event occurs on more than one level of a social media network, this approach is possible to extract the tasks from a CBD. We assess the proposed model against models regarded to be state-of-the-art using a broad spectrum of text corpora datasets. Regarding cases of cyberbullying directed against cancer sufferers, the results show that the CapsNet classification approach has a higher accuracy than the approaches now in use.

articleTitle: Advancing Visual Marketing Strategies Through Deep Learning-Based Image Recognition for Improved Customer Engagement and Brand Visibility
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: This paper aims at analyzing the effectiveness of utilizing deep learning-based image recognition in enhancing the visual marketing thereby determining the extent to which clients' attention and brand awareness are likely to be affected. It uses convolutional neural networking (CNN) to analyze and classify the visual content and the models used include VGG16, ResNet50, InceptionV3. An effective implementation of the data gathering, feature engineering, and algorithm development can be seen in the enhancing of the marketing effectiveness. This entails better accuracy of images in classification. This involves gaining high engagement rates from the customers. probabilities of high visibility of the brands across the various platforms. The study points at the possibility of deep learning technologies in changing visual marketing practices and therefore serves as a useful reference guide to business entity that wish to align themselves with adequate marketing practices in the growing digital landscape.

articleTitle: NPC Behavior in Games Using Unity ML-Agents: A Reinforcement Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Machine learning is having a significant impact on video games, from speeding up the development of new games to the development of new methods in gaming. This study discusses the impact of using ML models in the development and improvement of video games. Examples cited in this paper relate to the ways in which NPCs behave. With the aid of Unity's ML-Agents toolkit, developers can create NPCs that respond to different strategies in real time. This makes the games more exciting and complex. The paper also outlines the possibilities of single-player games, such as first-person shooters and a role-playing game, to notice NPC behavior during the gameplay. In these gaming styles, RL frameworks can be applied to NPCs to enable them to learn and adapt to the environment to create an interactive experience for the player. The conclusions put an emphasis on the evolution of video games with the advent of ML tools; as predicted, NPC behavior becomes more intuitive and less expected.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Farmer Reviews on Pesticides for Disease Management
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: In agriculture, managing plant diseases is important for keeping crops healthy and improving yields. Farmers use pesticides to control diseases, but choosing the right pesticide is often difficult because it depends on the type of disease, the environment, and the specific needs of the crops. This makes it hard for farmers to know which pesticide will work best. While there have been some methods to assess pesticide effectiveness, no projects focus directly on using farmer reviews to help with pesticide selection. This is a gap that needs to be filled to help farmers make better decisions. This research proposes a new solution by analyzing farmer reviews on pesticides using sentiment analysis. We use a deep learning model called Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM) combined with GloVe word embeddings that have been pre-trained. to understand the sentiment in the reviews. The BiLSTM model helps improve the accuracy of sentiment classification by considering both forward and backward text dependencies. Our model processes a dataset of disease names, pesticide names, and reviews, classifying them as positive, neutral, or negative. The results allow us to rank pesticides based on how effective they are for specific diseases. This approach gives farmers a better tool to choose the right pesticide for disease management.

articleTitle: Scalable AI Models for Real-Time Ethical Decision-Making in Autonomous Business Operations
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: This study explores the application of scalable AI for real-time ethical decision-making in autonomous business running. The study takes into an account the crucial concerns i.e., the bias, fairness, robustness etc., working on the congruency of ethics and operational efficiency. This research investigates AI's impact on decision quality through a series of analyses interpreting visuals (in the form of decision accuracy comparisons, stakeholder satisfaction, and resilience when facing adversarial scenarios). Results show that scalable AI models display higher ethical adaptability and an ability to learn from changing regulatory and operational environments. The research emphasises the need for proper balance of morals and technological advancement in order to enable transparency, accountability, and reliability in autonomous devices.

articleTitle: Hybrid Learning in Medical Imaging: CNN-SVM Applications in Lung Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Despite progress achieved in the ongoing fight against cancer, lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer death globally, which substantiates the need for rapid and accurate diagnostic methods. This research presents a heterogeneous model that uses CNNs for feature extraction and SVMs for classification. The LIDC-IDRI dataset was used to assess the model. Due to this, several major diseases such backlash the production of rice; Bacterial Blight, Blast, Brown Spot, Scald, Narrow Brown Leaf Spot, Neck Blast, Rice Hispa, and Sheath Blight encourage the need for early and efficient disease identification. In this study, we integrated the Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) block to improve the accuracy of the ResNet50V2 deep-learning model for rice disease identification. Using the Kaggle rice leaf diseases dataset, we trained the model on a dataset of 2880 images and then tested it on 720 images, utilizing the SE block to enhance the model's focus on the features that matter, by channel-wise attention recalibration. Among the outputs, we see that the modified model testing accuracy is 93.33, original ResNet50V2 accuracy is 83.61. The new model had a few more parameters (25,140,368 versus 24,620,289) than the prior version, but that minor increase was greatly outshined by the new model's diagnostic accuracy. The results indicate that the inclusion of the SE block enhances the performance of the models with almost no additional computation, therefore serving as a promising approach for agricultural disease diagnosis, especially in regions with limited resources.

articleTitle: Real-Time Monitoring of Sleep Patterns Using Wearable EEG Sensors
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Novel approach in sleep research and monitoring: Real-time monitoring of sleep patterns using wearable EEG sensors. It works using non-invasive EEG sensors that can be placed on the head. This enables the continuous and personalized tracking and assessment of sleep patterns. This kind of detailed information on various phases associated with sleep has the possibility of dramatically changing diagnoses and management related to sleep problems. Sleep disorders are typically under diagnosed or misdiagnosed today because traditional approaches self-report or overnight sleep studies only provide limited data. These newly developed wearable EEG sensors are lightweight and comfortable, which makes the latter ideal for long-term use. They are also provided with a wireless connection to an external monitoring system to enable the real-time transfer of data. This allows a more detailed examination of sleep cycles, including total time spent in each stage, along with disruptions via apnea and somnambulism. The potential applications of this technology are fully connected to daily devices used like smart watches and fitness trackers, which could benefit more people in a wider range for self-monitoring and tracking purposes on sleeping patterns.

articleTitle: Employee Perception Towards Workplace Ethics: A Study on Manufacturing Industries in Chennai
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Background: Ethical behaviour in the workplace determines a lot about workers' behaviour, degree of satisfaction, and company growth. The nature of the operations carried out by manufacturing industries creates particular ethical challenges. Problem Statement: Among these challenges are those connected to respect of environmental standards, following safety regulations, and labour management. Manufacturing sectors are one well-known main driver of economic growth. This study seeks to understand how Chennai-based manufacturing sector employees see workplace ethics. Objective: The objective is to identify the main factors influencing their points of view and evaluate how these opinions influence organisational performance and employee satisfaction. The study employs a mixed-methods approach, combining into its methodology qualitative interviews with quantitative questionnaires. Three hundred employees of ten different manufacturing companies answered well crafted questionnaires. The polls addressed ethical-related standards including conflict resolution, openness, fairness, and safety compliance. Findings: Statistical tools enable the quantitative study to reveal that 78% of workers believe that ethical behaviour is essential for job satisfaction and that 65% of them think that a lack of ethical standards drives more turnover rates. Moreover, 72% of the participants underlined the need of moral leadership during the process of creating a decent working culture. Strong ethical systems help businesses to retain 23% more employees and raise general productivity by 18% when compared to companies with less ethical basis. The findings highlight the need of creating a sustainable workplace by means of moral policies and staff member involvement in ethical training courses.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Energy Storage Management with Advanced Battery Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: The growing demand for renewable electricity resources has improved the need for green and reliable electricity storage structures. Batteries have emerged as one of the number one solution for storing renewable electricity. However, the overall performance and lifespan of those batteries are limited due to factors including temperature fluctuations, charging and discharging costs, and aging. To address those demanding situations, there's a need for advanced battery management algorithms that can optimize battery performance while ensuring safety and prolonging its lifespan. This assignment aims to revolutionize electricity garage management with the aid of growing superior battery algorithms, which could, as it should be, eliminate battery degradation and optimize performance based on actual-time information. These algorithms will contain machine getting-to-know strategies to evolve to convert environmental situations and usage styles, thereby maximizing battery performance and storage capacity. Additionally, those algorithms permit the mixing of different types of batteries into an unmarried device, considering a more flexible and green energy storage answer. The implementation of these advanced battery algorithms is predicted to have a considerable impact on the renewable power region, making it extra dependable, price-powerful, and sustainable. It can boost the adoption of renewable power sources and make contributions to the worldwide intention of lowering carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Real-Time Analytics for Big Data in Smart City Applications: Transforming Urban Environments with Data-Driven Insights
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: This paper offers an overview of real-time analytics for smart cities proposing a framework for real-time data processing to improve the urban landscape. In the proposed system, large-scale data-streams can be processed using advanced machine learning algorithms, edge computing, and distributed data storage. Analyzing the outcomes of the evaluation procedure evidences reportable performance enhancements in the areas of smart city applications. Average traffic speed in transportation systems in the same period rose by 60%, concurrency and response to incidents likewise cut down by 40% and 53% respectively. The energy management systems responded with a 16% decrease in maximum energy load and the waste reduction was by 50%, while the costs savings was by 25% increase. Public safety applications alone realised a 60% decrease in the time taken to detect a crime and a 28.6% increase in efficiency on disaster resources with an overall spike in public satisfaction of 25.7%. Such findings improve the understanding of how this framework can increase urban efficiency, sustainability, and quality of life, which makes the solution usable in future smart city projects.

articleTitle: Dynamic Knowledge Graphs for Predictive Business Insights: A Fusion of NLP and Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: We introduce a framework that utilizes dynamic nowledge graphs (DKGs), graph neural networks (GNNs) and natural language processing (NLP) to provide predictive business insights. This integration allows for efficient data extraction, real-time updates, and cross-domain applicability. This seamless integration not only enhances scalability and explainability but also integrates advanced security measures, providing businesses with actionable insights leading to faster and more strategic decision-making. Experimental results show improvements in handling large and dynamic datasets with no loss in accuracy or performance. The framework demonstrates how diverse networks from the fields of retail, healthcare, and finance can leverage generalization capabilities to enable decision makers to derive strategic actions from the available data. Notably, this work highlights the enabling power of DKG for a new paradigm of dynamic real-time intelligent decisionmaking that addresses the intricacies of business process dynamics. Utilizing the power of advanced AI, the framework fills the void between unrefined data and actionable insights, establishing itself as a powerful asset for tackling contemporary business challenges.

articleTitle: The Role of Behavioral Finance In Investment Decision-Making Using Machine Learning-Understanding the Psychology Behind Stock Market Trends
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Background: By investing decision-making, behavioral finance assists one to better understand the psychological aspects impacting stock market patterns. The conventional wisdom on finance assumes that reasonable decision-making occurs. Behavioral finance, on the other hand, draws attention to the heuristics and preconceptions influencing investing choices. Problem Statement: These address overconfidence, herd behavior, cover loss aversion. The question under study is how these cognitive biases influence personal portfolio strategies and market movements, therefore producing likely mispricing and volatility. Findings: The study maps behavioral trends using a simulation model comprising historical market data and investor sentiment monitoring via machine learning, so including psychological elements shown by Results of a one thousand trading day simulation showing a 15.2% increase in expected accuracy when compared with conventional models. Outcome: This outcome also revealed clear relationships between sentiment-driven trading and price fluctuations. One instance of this would be the measurement of loss aversion, which showed a twenty percent drop in risk tolerance after a negative market shock. Moreover, the findings of this study underscore the significance of adding psychological insights into investment techniques to gain more accurate forecasting and portfolio management.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Optimization Techniques for Accurate Melanoma Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Melanoma is the deadliest form of skin cancer, claiming more than 7,000 lives each year in the United States; roughly 67, where there were almost over196 new cases URITY CASES ANNUALLY IN THE US. Because of its visual similarity to non-melanomas, it is more important than ever that melanoma be discovered early for effective treatment. As per the research, machine learning (ML) techniques have gained high popularity for automated image analysis and classification during melanoma diagnosis, and they have assisted dermatologists in diagnosing efficiently. At the same time, the performance of ML models relies on how optimization techniques are implemented in training. ML optimization tools buck as gradient descent and poor initialization may result in black-box solutions that could lead to misdiagnosis. New approaches with deep learning and reinforcement have led to dramatic improvements in the performance of machine-learning models over the last several years. Historically, deep learning algorithms have proven highly accurate in classifying melanoma images because they can automatically learn complex features from the data. In addition, they tried to optimize the feature selected and make your ML model interpretable by using the reinforcement learning method, which searches for an optimal solution through a trial-and-error process. Conclusion Optimization of machine learning techniques is essential for providing accurate melanoma diagnosis. Recent years of the digital revolution, stupefied by advanced arguments like Deep Learning and Reinforcement learning models, have contributed to high accuracy in Machine learning models a dream come true for dermatologists with timely detection & cement of this deadly disease.

articleTitle: Real-Time Object Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks for Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: This is where timely and accurate detection by autonomous cars becomes vital. Due to this, Convolution Neural Networks have gained the utmost popularity in object detection and are showing great potential in performing all sorts of sort's r vision tasks. In this project, we propose a Convolution Neural Networks based real-time object detection system for autonomous vehicles. Our system detects and localizes real-time objects based on deep neural network architecture. The function of our software is to take an image from the sensors, like cameras or Liar, on board this car. This image is further input to CNN, which takes these features, extracts the object, and classifies them into a scene. As we previously mentioned, CNN is trained with a large dataset of labeled images, allowing it to recognize hundreds or thousands of different objects accurately. This is then computed further in the CNN and attempts to find bounding boxes around detected objects, giving where that object exists spatially in a scene. Our system's response time has been designed for real-time analysis and should be able to analyze images and detect objects in about milliseconds. This, in return, enables autonomous vehicles to make immediate decisions when considering these objects and navigate safely. Our system allows for real-time object detection, opening the door to high-performance and safe autonomous vehicles that bring us closer than ever before to achieving full autonomy driving.

articleTitle: Real-Time Crop Health Assessment with MobileNet for Agricultural Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: The growth of sustainable and efficient farming systems has necessitated the use of automated crop health monitoring systems. In the current study, a real-time crop health assessment is proposed using a deep learning algorithm called MobileNet based on a lightweight CNN. The method under consideration includes using the camera of a smartphone to take detailed photographs of crops growing in the fields, and with the help of the MobileNet model, distinguish diseases, nutrient deficiencies, and other pathologies. To provide some resistance to variations in environmental circumstances, the current images are preprocessed through resizing, normalization, and augmentation. MobileNet model fine-tuning is made using a richer dataset that includes both healthy and disease crop images The model achieves an accuracy of 94.5% and micro-average of precision, recall, and F1-score of 95.3%, 93.7%, and 94.5% respectively. Real-time efficiency tests are performed on disparate mobile devices and show that the system took less than 2 seconds on average to generate results and had a model size of 12 MB, suitable for usage on even minimalresource devices. Moreover, the trained model demonstrates relatively irgendeepstance to image brightness and orientation, which is rather advantageous for its practical application on the agricultural fields. This paper presents a possible practical and effective approach to field use, which will allow for improving precision agriculture, as well as the preservation of the environment and agricultural lands.

articleTitle: The Role of Blockchain Technology in Enhancing Network Security
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Blockchain technology has received much attention for its digital storage and security applications. Blockchain technology has many benefits regarding network security, including decentralization, immutability and transparency, which can significantly increase the level of protection for networks. Decentralization is one of the key advantages that blockchain can bring to network security. Conventional network security systems have control of data, which is all centralized in front of a single entity, making them easily attacked. On the other hand, blockchain technology decentralizes data control and therefore, the distribution of potential hacking in nodes makes it almost impossible to hack or breach the entire network. Specifically, the blockchain is immutable; its construction protects against any data modification occurring on the network when no vote by a majority of nodes permits a change. It renders cybercriminals nearly incapable of modifying the network data, which adds an extra layer of protection. Transparency is another key feature of blockchain technology since all participants in the network will have access to view any transaction conducted on the network. This functionality helps monitor any unauthorized or suspicious activity on the network, providing a chance to be vigilant and address the issue.

articleTitle: Optical Cross-Connect Technologies for Flexible Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Various optical cross-connect technologies are being developed for flexible next-generation optical networks to ensure the efficiency of real-time optical network routing. Demand for larger bandwidth and faster data transmission continues to grow. Therefore, these networks are becoming more and more significant. Conventional optical cross-connects offer limited scalability, and they need to be more flexible by nature due to their traditional architecture, hindering fast adaptation to altering traffic patterns. A solution to this problem is the new OXC technologies, which allow dynamic and reconfigurable optical networks. These technologies use high-end optics and electronics, including wavelength-selective switches and coherent receivers, to offer routing and switching flexibility. One key benefit of flexible OXC technologies is that their capabilities to support different transmission formats and data rates cater well to specific service requisites. They also allow for greater implementation of software-defined networking principles, creating centralized control and management over the network. Moreover, flexible OXCs enable efficient tower best practices and O&M savings through reduced manual network intervention.

articleTitle: Optimizing Battery Energy Efficiency and Power Consumption for Extended Range in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Electric-powered motors (EVs) are gaining a reputation as an alternative to conventional fuel-powered motors because of their environmental advantages and rising fuel charges. However, their restrained battery range and excessive energy intake are giant limitations to their substantial adoption. To deal with those problems, this venture aims to optimize the battery power performance and energy consumption of EVs for a prolonged variety. First of all, the battery utilization may be optimized through superior electricity control algorithms. This will involve predicting and managing the energy needs of the car via sensible, manipulated structures. By optimizing battery utilization, the overall strength performance of the vehicle will be expanded, making an allowance for an extended range. Secondly, the power intake of the EV can be optimized by using lightweight materials, green motor and drivetrain designs, and advanced regenerative braking systems. This technology will lessen the strength required to strengthen the automobile, further increasing its variety. Moreover, the project will develop clever charging strategies for EV proprietors to price their motors at some stage in off-height hours while energy is cheaper and the grid is less congested. This may reduce energy consumption and improve battery life.

articleTitle: Real-Time Indoor Localization Using IoT and Sensor Networks for Human Activity Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: To develop an effective real-time indoor localization methodology by exploiting the Internet of Things (IoT) consists of sensor networks. This tech is to support a more robust HAM application that allows for precise and continuous tracking based on individual locations inside buildings. It uses a combination of IoT devices and sensors to give people in the indoor environment real-time positioning data. Real-time indoor Localization based on IoT and Sensor Networks is a technology that allows evaluating precise continuous tracking of individuals in buildings to monitor human activity by applying advanced techniques such as Wireless sensor networks. Essentially, this technology leverages IoT devices and sensors to give precise real-time location information of people inside buildings. This accurate and reliable indoor positioning uses advanced techniques such as wireless sensor networks, lowenergy Bluetooth, and IoT technologies like RFID; this technology can be achieved only in Hospitals, shopping malls, and offices where it enables you to track human activities from indoor spaces at the current moment”Ǆ Installing sensors and IoT devices throughout the building connected to a central data center or via Natural Activity Limit Parametrization Real-time indoor localization using the Internet of Things (IoT) and sensor networks enables accurate tracking for human activity monitoring inside buildings. This technology uses IoT devices with sensors to give people precise real-time information on their location in an indoor space. This technology provides highly precise and reliable indoor positioning with advanced techniques such as wireless sensor networks, Bluetooth low energy, or RFID. The technology is best suited to tracking human activities in indoor spaces, including hospitals, shopping malls, and offices. This is followed by creating a data layer of network sensors and IOT devices inside the building connected to an on-premises or cloud central server. Sensors capture information from the movement of people and pass it to a server, which does all the processing and concludes in real time who is at what specific location. Applications of real-time indoor localization range from security and safety monitoring to healthcare and retail analytics.

articleTitle: Enhancing Customer Retention: A Federated Machine Learning Framework for Banking Churn Prediction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Customer attrition has become the significant challenge for the bank, making large volume of customers to migrate to other banks, as the banks keeps providing multiple benefits to the incoming customers. The loss due to migration of the existing customer to the competitive bankers creates the banking churn, means of loss of customer relationship with the bank, and affects the development, business and the profitability of the corresponding bank. It is essential to predict the banking churn with a primary objective of retaining the customers, considered as a critical task. To achieve this objective, banking sectors employ the customer behavioral analysis to determine the rate of customer churn, resulting in incorrect diagnosis of the churn rate. To over this concern, this research manuscript proposes a novel federated Machine Learning (ML) framework for the prediction of the customer churn, directly contributes for the enhancement of the customer retention. This proposed novel framework offers significant advancements for the banking prediction on customer retention, thus provides an accurate tool for the analysis of customer relationships. The proposed prediction framework is analyzed in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score and the performance is compared with the state of the art prediction methodologies.

articleTitle: The Role of Sensors in Autonomous Vehicles and its Impact on Smart Transportation Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Once at the forefront of a transformation in the transportation industry, autonomous vehicles have all but disappeared from our collective discourse. Most autonomous vehicles depend on sensors to detect what is around and make some decisions without human interference. Sensors are paramount in functioning AVs since they give real-time information regarding the vehicle's location, rate, and surrounding objects. The sensors here are for all purposes; some use cameras, while others use lidar, radar, and several ultrasonic sensors. Combining both gives the vehicle a 360-degree view and helps it maneuver safely through even the most complex environments. AV-cum-smart transport systems can help improve traffic flow and road safety and increase overall transportation efficiency. Sensors are critical to harnessing these benefits and allow the AVs to work by way of other vehicles or organization, such as circulation signals and road ciphers. This communication gets dynamic route planning so that the time of travel and fuel can be saved. Nevertheless, several challenges remain to be addressed with sensor reliability under any conditions; however adverse, they may still face serious opposition and cybersecurity. Further research and development in the area of sensor technology are imperative to bring AVs into common use, as well as for using smart transportation systems effectively.

articleTitle: Integrated Photonic Routing and Switching for Scalable Optical Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: The rapid increase in demand for higher data transfer rates and scalability, especially in data centers and other networks, has resulted in the emergence of Integrated Photonic Routing and switching technology for optical interconnects. IPRS uses integrated photonics, a technology that allows multiple photonic functions to be integrated on one chip to build scalable, high-speed optical networks. It replaces conventional electronic switches, constrained by system bandwidth and energy dissipation, with efficient, high-performance photonic switches. The IPRS system contains photonic router/switching units that route the data signals through different routing paths and finally switch them to the appropriate output port. A scalable photonic interconnect network that scales to interconnect without performance loss connects these units. It enables highly interoperable and flexible optical networks that can satisfy the increasing demand for data transmission. Likewise, integrated photonics are associated with numerous unique benefits in IPRS, such as decreased power consumption, more extensive bandwidth, and less delay than electronic interconnects. In addition, combining several photonic functionalities on a single chip leads to a small-size and low-cost solution that can be used to integrate thousands of chips into large-scale optical networks. This process to fabricate devices and integrated photonics receivers technology brings the potential for scalable on-chip high-speed optical interconnects and further addresses performance scalabilities cost-effectively, which is required in data centers, supercomputers and other high-performance networks.

articleTitle: Applying CNNs for the Early Detection of Bone Malignant Tumors in X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Bone malignant tumors are cancerous growths that develop in the bones and can be fatal if they remain undiagnosed or untreated for a long time. Since these tumors often grow slowly, early detection is important for successful treatment and high survival rates. Existing medical imaging tools to detect bone malignant tumors, such as X-rays, utilize human expertise and are time-consuming. Thus, recently, computer-aided diagnosis systems have been developed primarily with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). Convolutional neural networks are deep learning models proven to perform highly on pattern recognition tasks, especially in image and video analysis. In this paper, we suggest that CNNs be used in the early finding of bone malignant tumors using X-ray images. It starts by preprocessing the X-ray images before entering them into CNN to perform feature extraction. The resampling data was then used to teach the CNN where one class is “normal,” and another class has an abnormal, namely a bone malignant tumor. The system's performance was tested on a dataset consisting of X-ray images obtained from patients with bone malignant tumors. Results showed high detection accuracy for both these tumors with sensitivity and specificity of < 90% (Table 2). This work demonstrates the potential value of CNNs for early bone malignant tumor detection, and therefore, their use in clinical care will help health professionals make prompt and correct diagnoses.

articleTitle: Hybrid CNN-RNN Models for Multimodal Analysis of Autism Spectrum Disorder Neuroimaging
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: ASD is a developmental disorder in the neurological category and has numerous and diverse symptoms. Diagnosis is still problematic because symptoms of parkinsonism are diverse, and the dimensionality of the neuroimaging data is high. This paper presents a combination of CNN and RNN for classifying the ASD by analyzing multimodal neuroimaging data such as fMRI data, MRI data, and DTI data. The CNN component analyzes spatial characteristics of the neuroimaging data, and the RNN learns temporal patterns in fMRI series. Enhancements include a novel preprocessing step called 3D Brain Region Alignment (3D-BRA) as well as the 3D version of Adaptive Temporal, minimizing dimensionality through an innovative feature selection technique employing EN-CC. Predictive analysis with the hybrid model utilizes standard benchmark datasets such as ABIDE I, ABIDE II, HCP, and SFARI and records classification performances over 95 percentage. To enhance the interpretability of the model, the Grad-CAM algorithm is used, which marks specific regions of the brain important in the context of ASD. The proposed framework seems to possess considerable feasibility for enhancing the diagnosis of ASD and improving the understanding of its neural substrates, making the developed method highly advantageous for applications in neuroinformatics and clinical utility.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Channel Estimation Techniques for 5G Communications
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: There has been a high demand for efficient and accurate channel estimation techniques to satisfy the need for 5G, which is moving towards high data rates and low latency applications. Most of the conventional methods, like Least Squares (LS) and Minimum Mean Square Error (MMSE), have yet to be able to meet these requirements. Due to this, an increase in the popularity of Machine Learning (ML) based channel estimation for 5G communications can be seen. Instead of using mathematical models, the ML-based channel estimation techniques make use of the strong computational power of ML algorithms to learn the behavior of the channel from training data. These techniques have been shown to be superior in accuracy and efficiency compared to classic methods, thus allowing better channel estimation and, as a result, a performance improvement at the system level. Additionally, due to the flexibility of ML-based methods, they can adapt to time-variant channel conditions and decrease computational complexity. Abstract: This paper discusses the different Machine Learning ML-based channel estimation techniques for 5G communications, which include deep learning approaches like neural network implementation, support vector machines, and Reinforcement learning.

articleTitle: Analysis of Convolutional Neural Network Architectures for Image Denoising and Restoration
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks have performed excellently in image processing applications such as Image Demising and Restoration. CNN's performance and accuracy depend on its design and architecture. This work analyzes delousing and image restoration using different CNN architectures. In this experiment, three popular CNN architectures, U-Net, Res Net, and Dense Net, are trained on different noise levels. In this section, we analyze each parameter for the proposed CNN models, i.e., filter size and depth, etc., to evaluate performance variations due to these hyper parameters. Our results indicate that with a longer network and large filter sizes, it may be possible to deny the images more accurately for restoration. This development set opened as we experimented with fine-tuning the other tasks (DE noising and restoration) using pretrained models. We provide empirical evidence that has shown that incorporating pretrained models can result in a substantial improvement in the performance of CNNs with a limited amount of data. This work represents a complete investigation of CNN architectures, such as DE noising and restoration, and explains why specific engineering choices are effective. These results can be useful in enhancing accuracy and performance for image processing tasks using CNN models.

articleTitle: Crop Yield Forecasting Using Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (Bi-GRU) Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Crop yield forecasting is an important aspect of the sustainable agriculture to help farmers and policy makers anticipate both production quantities and qualities, thus providing a technical tool for decision making. In this paper, a new technique of using Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (Bi-GRU) to forecast the growth rate of one or several crops with improved precision and credibility is introduced. The model used here utilizes sequence data of meteorological parameters, soil, satellite index, and yield data also to incorporate temporal dependency and non-linear trends. Imputation of missing values; normalization; feature scaling all helps to remove inconsistencies in data and improve model performance. Folically, the employment of the Bi-GRU model provided a significan improvement over traditional machine learning models and unidirectional models with RMSE of 460.3 kg/ha and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{R}^{2}$</tex> of 0.89. Moreover, hyperparameters tuning enhanced the model revealing the importance of bidirectional architecture in managing and capturing the past and future temporal contexts. Similar trends of increased TVB-accuracy arias were observed in sub-Regional analysis considering different crop types and environmental conditions and the accuracy prediction of the yield increased up to 14.1%. This work suggests that Bi-GRU networks can be beneficial to predict crop yields with predictive power, reliability, and fine-grained architectures to handle problems such as climate fluctuations and dataset heterogeneity. The study provides a solution of how to incorporate deep learning algorithms into smart agriculture systems for development, posterity.

articleTitle: Dark Patterns Detection on E-Commerce Websites
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Dark patterns are techniques employed on e-commerce website interfaces for the purpose of influencing users' actions to engage in undesirable behavior such as making unintentional purchases or submitting personal information when they did not want to. This is where this study seeks to address through identification of such patterns using a machine learning method. To cover false and genuine content, a dataset with 10,000 textual samples, obtained from several e-commerce sites, was compiled. Thus, for analysis, the easily interpretable classification model, Logistic Regression, was used. The results showed that the detection accuracy of the model is 92%, where precision and Recall metrics' point to the model's abilities to detect manipulative language. The results point to the ability of machine learning methods in detecting and combating fraud in cyberspace and thus promoting an ethical e-commerce market.

articleTitle: Biometric Sensors for Secure and Continuous Health Tracking in Healthcare Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: In the healthcare domain, biometric sensors are indispensable, as they enable secure and continuous health monitoring.
