The evaluation of the BiLSTM model demonstrates superior performance, achieving an accuracy86%, a precision90%, a recall86%, and an F1-score88% • A comparison between the model and other models such as SVM and CNN reveals the strength of the BiLSTM in contextual classification tasks. The results demonstrate that BiLSTM can tackle problems with hate speech detection, providing a strong answer to the problem of harmful content on social media and helping to make the internet a better place for everyone.

articleTitle: Optimizing Retail Operations with Big Data-Driven Insights: From Inventory Management to Personalized Marketing
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: In this paper, we look into the role of big data analytics in the strategic transition of retail businesses particularly on inventory management, supply chain and marketing. Using such technologies as big data and machine learning, retailers can find new patterns within such information that can lead to improved efficiency, and satisfaction of consumers. The study also shows noteworthy performance gain in areas of stock out and overstock, inventory Turns and delivery correctness. Even more, the approach to the customer targeting, that stemmed from the principles of the customer segmentation and recommendation systems, led to the growth of the conversion, customer loyalty, and customer lifetime value. The research evidence suggests that information-based management strategies contribute to organizational performance and sustained competitive advantage of firms operating in the retail sector. Issues like data integration, privacy and infrastructural, components are also addressed and hence making it easy form the basis of any future learning and trying out on the real life challenges. The current research focuses on the significance of big data for designing growth and innovation strategies in the changing retail environment.

articleTitle: Secure Multi-party Computation for Privacy Preservation in Collaborative Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Organizational and individual resource sharing is gaining significant attention in collaborative networks, focusing on the functioning of groups over various tasks. However, sharing sensitive data, such as personal information and intellectual property, makes security and privacy a big problem. This is work done in secure multi-party computation (SMPC), which is a very promising solution because, in SMPC, multiple parties can compute a certain function on their input data without revealing them to each other. Secure Multiparty Computation (SMPC) SMPC is a cryptographic technique that allows multiple parties to compute a function over their input data sets while keeping those inputs private. The promise of a new computing environment enabling everyone to calculate in the dark, so no one sees or even knows the data being processed exists, is achieved through sophisticated cryptographic algorithms and protocols that split the computation among partners without ever revealing the underlying data. In this abstract, we provide an overview of the state-of-the-art regarding SMPC for privacy preservation in collaborative networks. This paper highlights the challenges and opportunity areas in adopting Secure Multi-Party Computation within a collaborative networking ecosystem, along with the advantages of this methodology. It has also been SMPC, a great offer of real-world use to share information in health networks, financial transactions, and between organizations. In conclusion, this abstract highlights the significance of privacy preservation for collaborative networks and demonstrates that SMPC can be a potential candidate for realizing such a mechanism.

articleTitle: Cyber-Physical Systems in Disaster Management: Real-Time Data Collection and Analysis for Improved Response
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Disaster management is one of the applications where cyber-physical systems play a significant role by allowing real-time data collection and analysis. Such systems consist of physical, computational and communication elements and enable the automatic exchange of information between machines and humans and decision-making in disaster situations. This technology can change the method of disaster response to a more automated one, and it could reduce the amount of manual data collection and analysis. In disaster management, CPS consists of a set of interconnected devices, including sensors, drones and mobile devices monitoring different factors of the disaster: assessing damage, environmental conditions and survivor whereabouts. This information is sent to a central hub for processing and real-time analysis. This information is then fed into models to assess risk, identify hot spots and guide rescue and relief operations. CPS enables disaster response teams to utilize live data, which means decisions can be made faster and more accurately.

articleTitle: Leveraging Deep Learning Techniques for Tuberculosis Detection from X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: This paper presents a thorough approach to developing a tuberculosis detection system with the help of deep learning algorithm on chest X-ray images. In this work, pretrained convolutional neural network models are applied to analyse their performance in detecting tuberculosis. It includes a preprocessing stage of resizing, denoising, normalisation, and data augmentation to strengthen the property of images and their compatibility with the models. The architectures detailed are of ResNet50, VGG-19 deep convolutional layers, and the made-from-scratch custom CNN structure-emphasising each strength in that it is utilised within image classification. The models are evaluated based on ROC curves, precision-recall analysis, and F1 scores to get a balanced prospect of the model's performance. This makes this VGG-19 model of high accuracy and stable reliability. This is further followed by designing a web application integrated with the trained VGG-19 model, where X-ray images can be uploaded for the recognition of TB by end users. The human-friendly interface will also help medical professionals and general users obtain explicit diagnostic results, hence increasing the applicability of deep learning in healthcare diagnostics. This project can transform the detection and treatment outcomes of diseases by making massive contributions to global health using advanced deep-learning techniques in medical diagnosis.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Robustness of RSA Encryption Against Sophisticated Cyber Attacks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: RSA encryption is a widely used cryptographic system for securing records and verbal exchange on the internet. It relies on the computational trouble of factoring big integers to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of statistics. However, with the increasing sophistication of cyber-attacks, it is important to assess the robustness of RSA encryption in opposition to capability vulnerabilities. This technical abstract offers an examination of the goals of evaluating the electricity of RSA encryption in opposition to numerous state-of-the-art cyber assaults. Intrusion detection systems were created to solve the problems with many threats, such as secure protocols and authentication mechanisms. Another important aspect is privacy since these devices collect a large amount of data that can be used to infer potentially sensitive personal information. Some solutions to protect privacy in IoT and sensor networks have been suggested, such as encryption methods, data anonymization algorithms, or access control mechanisms. In addition, scalability, energy-efficient design, and cost are key challenges in devising such security and privacy solutions. To that end, research is being conducted to enhance existing solutions and develop new methods and technologies for tackling these challenges. To sum up, IoT and sensor networks are inherently rewarding technologies whose benefits far outweigh their drawbacks, but justifiably, many threats must be cleared to gain those attributes at the expense of reasonable security and privacy potentials. The current solutions are baseline, but they need continuous upgradation to ensure the safety and privacy of users in such a fast-moving technology world.

abstract: They involve monitoring and analyzing daanalyzeeal-time, real-time farmers to derive key insights on their crops or soil at any given time. A farmer can, in near real-time, for instance, decide to change the timing of irrigation based on measured soil moisture and how much water is required. Drones can also provide a high-level image of the farm using specialized cameras, sensors, and on-ground sensors. They are capable of taking high-defbig-bitmaps-big and sensing subtle changes. IoT and Sensor-Enabled Drones in Agriculture Crop Monitoring: There is a huge potential in using IoT & sensor-caped drones for precision agriculture and crop monitoring. They also have the potential to revolutionize farming techniques, making them more sustainable, efficient, and cheap. Large-scale data collection and analysis capabilities allow farmers to optimize yields through data-driven decision-making. Precision agriculture and crop monitoring Since farmers can make the best decisions based on real-time data, it is one of the most exciting IoT applications in the internet landscape. These technologies allow data about crops and soil levels to be instantaneously and analyzed quickly. IoT sensors can measure the temperature, humidity, soil moisture, and other parameters across farms. The data could then be sent to a central database or cloud for analysis and further decision-making based on the studies. Therefore, agriculture farmers can determine the optimal irrigation schedule based on real-time soil moisture levels. Thus, water is being conserved, and even more important, crop yield will be increased. articleTitle: Fiber Optic Communication Systems for Next-Generation Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: The evolution of urbanization and the variety of information communication technologies have given birth to the idea of Smart Cities those territories that aspire to improve the lifestyle standards for their inhabitants through development technologies. Communication network infrastructures are the foundation of a smart city where information and services seamlessly flow between them. This era of communication faces challenges not only in reaching millions of users through relatively limited current process technologies but also in the increased demand for high throughput and low latency services, etc. Fiber optic communication systems are the most promising and effective solutions, with properties like high bandwidth, back-to-back transmission at low delay periods, and immunity to electromagnetic noise source devices among various existing commercial technologies. They utilize fiber optic cables to transmit data in the form of light pulses, which enables a faster and less susceptible means of communication. Fiber optic communications systems will grow as the need for smart city applications increases. Designs of next-generation fiber optic systems will meet smart city requirements, including high-speed data transmission, low power consumption and costeffectiveness. These configurations employ advanced technologies, including wavelength division multiplexing, coherent detection and modulation techniques for improved speed and distance capabilities.

articleTitle: Integrating Blockchain Technology for Secure and Decentralized Network Communication
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: It is a distributed and decentralized database that protects transparent transaction records. While this technology has been mainly related to crypto currencies, it has a potential application in improving network communication. For instance, the centralized nature of communication can make room for vulnerabilities, including data leakage and single points of failure in a traditional client-server model. You will not have a single point of failure in network effects as communication can be decentralized with block chain. Block chain technology is distributed by nature. Hence, the data is shared and stored on multiple nodes, making it almost impossible for an attacker to modify it. Lastly, Block chain technology offers encryption and authentication for safe device communication without intermediaries. This mitigates the chance of man-in-the-middle attacks and thus helps with data confidentiality and integrity. Besides, using smart contracts in block chain allows attendees to communicate as much as possible without human interference. The introduction of block chain technology in network communication can provide a secure and decentralized solution between client nodes and servers to maintain data privacy and integrity.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of a Rooftop Solar-Wind Energy System for Residential Buildings
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Today, we are experiencing a rise in the need for clean and renewable energy, which is why solar and wind energy systems • are included in residential buildings. This paper investigates the design and performance analysis of a rooftop solar wind energy system for residential buildings. The system proposed combines a solar panel with a wind turbine that is mounted on the roof of a building. Photovoltaic panels work only in the sun, whereas wind turbines generate from the air. The system is designed based on the building location, available roof space, and residents' energy requirements. This performance analysis involves an evaluation of energy production, efficiency, and cost efficacy. The research also compares the system to conventional grid-tied and off-grid solar systems. This report reveals that the solar-wind system has a good potential to generate more electrical energy than the traditional way, making it an economic and ecological energy resource in household buildings. Moreover, solar coupled with wind energy are suitable for both -- providing firmness and predictability to both sources. The system also has the potential to decrease a residential building's overall carbon impact, thereby enhancing global green initiatives.

articleTitle: Building Resilient Supply Chains with IoT and Advanced Analytics: A Path to Operational Excellence
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Recent global supply chain challenges have revealed that resilience has become crucial to the operational success of supply chains. Presenting the findings of this study, this research looks at how the advent of the Internet of Things (IoT) and analytical tools have gone a long way towards strengthening the supply chain. A large number of devices like sensors, RFID tags, and smart machinery connected to the supply chain help the organizations to track and monitor the process in order to make the right decisions, identify problems which may occur in the future and thus optimize the potential of supply chains. Combined with other related technologies including machine learning, artificial intelligence, big data analytics, the supply chain managers can process abundance of data to look for threats, compare the changing demand patterns and respond in advance. This paper presents several industrial applications of IoT and advanced analytics in supply chain and illustrates how the integration of the two technologies improve flexibility, avoid risk and increases the supply chain performance. The work also looks at the problems that accompany adoption of these technologies such as security, integration as well as the workforce skills required to support the implementations. In sum, this work articulates a conceptual model for managing IoT and Big Data in the pursuit of business productivity and economic viability in a complex and volatile global environment.

articleTitle: Enabling Smart Farming with IoT and Sensor Networks: Case Studies from Developing Countries
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Smart Farming with IOT and Sensor Networks is an advanced technology that enables traditional farmers to reduce waste and introduce intelligence in measuring the productivity of crops. The papers show how deploying IOT and sensor networks has contributed to enhancing productivity, reducing costs, and sustainability through a few successful case studies spanning regions under development. IOT and Sensor Networks for Agriculture: Low-cost sensors and communication devices with data analytics help collect and analyze real-time information from farms. Along with weather forecasts, soil analysis, and other useful insights, it helps farmers take technocratic actions, eventually allowing them to use their resources better. IOT and sensor networks are particularly useful in developing countries, where small-scale farmers often cannot access modern technologies and information. Farmers using IOT systems for drip irrigation can use their mobile phones to control watering remotely and thus increase water efficiency significantly, as was the case in India. Leveraging sensor networks to advance precision farming has successfully grown crops with higher yields and less fertilizer use in Africa. Using IOT and sensor networks in the application layer can significantly enhance food security, diminish ecological footprint, and foster sustainable agricultural practices, particularly in developing countries. The world has a later taste of the benefits that would eventuate in one dark-haired roommate becoming somewhat more bearded and less university student-like than ever before; there is still much research to come on this technology, which could change the face (not beard)of global agriculture - improving livelihoods for millions upon million small-scale farmers.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Melanoma Through Deep Learning-Based Skin Lesion Classification Using VGG16 and InceptionV3
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: This work aims at investigating classification of skin lesion in order to detect melanoma using deep learning models such as VGG16 and InceptionV3. Skin cancer especially the melanoma needs proper identification for cure to be administered on the affected tissues. The research which underpins this application makes use of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in an effort to decide whether skin lesions are benign or malignant. In the present study, to assess the performance of the suggested models, the dermoscopic image data set in the public domain was used for training VGG16 and InceptionV3 models. The experimental evaluation demonstrated that, in comparison to the VGG16 network and other relevant algorithms, including ResNet50 and DenseNet121, InceptionV3 provides higher accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, as well as the ROC-AUC value. InceptionV3 delivered 91.5 % classification accuracy and 92.1 % F1 score representing the enhanced melanoma diagnosis capability of the algorithm with fewer statistical errors between the true positive and true negative cases. The broad fractal dimension analysis feature of the proposed model means that variations in lesion size and texture do not pose a challenge to it. The deep learning models take more time in training than the traditional machine learning methods, although their outcomes justify their employment in clinical practices. The study identifies InceptionV3 as a viable tool for analysis of melanoma images with a view to assist the doctors in early identification of the disease hence enhancing the generality of patients prognosis.

articleTitle: Integrating Regression Models and Deep Learning for Lung Cancer Risk Prediction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Early diagnosis is vital for successful treatment of lung cancer, as the disease remains one of the most common causes of death by cancer worldwide. Historically, the prediction of lung cancer has been based on regression models and disemboweled by the fact that it cannot optimally handle complex data. In contrast, deep learning techniques have exhibited great potential in developing precise predictive models of disease based on more complicated forms of data; nevertheless, these methods have been less rigorously applied specifically for predicting lung cancer risks. This project aims to combine conventional regression models and deep learning techniques to achieve better performance with more generalizable accuracy for lung cancer risk prediction. A hybrid framework will be developed, exploiting the strengths of regression models in being interpretable and deep learning for its superior prediction. Our proposed methodology will also tackle the issue of high-dimensional imaging data needed for lung cancer risk prediction. These advances in notably conjunctional regression models and deep learning may contribute to better prediction models for lung cancer risk by enhancing the accuracy and translation ability of the developed scores. It will help improve the identification of people at high risk for lung cancer and, on that note, also target the population likely to benefit, thereby ensuring early controls with better outcomes.

articleTitle: Malignant Tumor Classification Using Hybrid CNN-SVM Models in Medical Imaging
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Automatic classification of malignant tumors has become particularly important in medical imaging because early detection and accurate diagnosis can dramatically improve patient outcomes. These days, deep learning techniques have demonstrated an out-sized success in numerous fields of medical imaging, such as tumor classification. In this paper, we present a hybrid CNN-SVM model used for classifying malignant tumors in medical imaging. In this paper, we take the fugitive approach by using CNN to segment tumor regions, and SVM is used to classify cancer as Benign or Malignant. For categorization, CNN is employed to eliminate the high-level features from the medical pictures sustained by that SVM. Our study is implemented as a hybrid model that learns from an expansive collection of medical images with benign and malignant tumors. Finally, to evaluate the performance of our model, we compared it with referenced models (traditional CNN and SVM) on the same dataset. The results indicated that the hybrid model CNN-SVM is superior in terms of higher accuracy and fewer error rates. Additional experiments on a new dataset demonstrate the model's generalization capability, which can be beneficial in practical applications.

articleTitle: Spectrum Sensing and Allocation Techniques in Cognitive Radio Networks with Primary User Traffic
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Cognitive radio is a novel technology for increasing spectral efficiency by enabling secondary users (SUs) to access bands of spectrum that are allocated but currently unused unsensed primary users (PUs). However, Spectrum sensing is one essential operation that helps to Sense all the available Primary Users (PUs) so that the Secondary Users (SUs) can detect them and avoid interference. For this purpose, several spectrum sensing techniques have been suggested. Matched filter detection or Coherent Detection [6], and Cyclostationary-based detection that exploit different features of the received signal to sense PUs. Spectrum allocation is as important as spectrum sensing in CR networks. SUs might need help finding a spectrum band that is free for their transmissions since the system still allows SUs to access (contaminated) PU traffic. To combat this, different spectrum assignment mechanisms have been proposed, including opportunistic spectrum access (OSA) and dynamic spectrum access (DSA), allowing for SUs to opportunistically use some potential vacant bands based on heterogeneity in the temporal availability of these bands and allowing them to dynamically acquire/release shared spectrum according to QoS requirements.

articleTitle: Automated Leukemia Detection Using EfficientNetB3: A Robust Deep Learning Approach for Accurate and Efficient Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Leukemia is a malignant hematological disease, and its diagnosis has to be performed as early and as precisely as possible in order to help improve the prognosis. Classical diagnostic methodologies involve many time-consuming activities that are heavily dependent on the expertise of specialists, such as microscopic examination of blood smears. Recent breakthroughs in deep learning and computer vision have opened new perspectives for automatic disease detection, improving both accessibility and reliability of diagnostics. This work describes the application of EfficientNetB3, a high-performance CNN architecture to automate the diagnosis of leukemia from microscopic blood smear images. Given that EfficientNetB3 enjoys a reputation for striking a great balance between efficiency and accuracy, thanks to its strategy for scaling depth, width, and resolution by compound scaling, which, in turn, enhances its feature learning capabilities even on constrained resource settings. Considering the model was trained on a comprehensive dataset, it achieved a very high test accuracy of 93.75%. That brought out the effectiveness with which the model could segregate leukemic cells from healthy blood samples almost with a very high degree of precisions. Further assurances about its robustness and applicative potential in clinical scenarios come from metrics like sensitivity, specificity, and F1-score. Results have shown that EfficientNetB3 could be the perfect tool for the detection of leukemia, opening the possibilities of integration into automated diagnostic workflows. The approach might act in boosting the complimentary pace of the diagnosis to help health professionals make early intervention in leukemia. Further optimizations using data augmentation, and hyperparameter fine-tuning might be done towards improving diagnostic accuracy and adaptability across different leukemia subtypes.

articleTitle: Harnessing CNN and LSTM Models for Enhanced Predictive Maintenance in Industrial IoT Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: In this research, the problem of predictive maintenance using the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) systems is investigated with the use of hybrid Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) models. Depending on the temporal dependency in the sensor data we want to bring in the LSTM to capture the temporal relations in the data as well as to extract the spatial feature using the CNN. Using publicly available IIoT datasets, including NASA Prognostics Data Repository to train and evaluate the models. It results in accuracy of 94.5% vs traditional machine learning algorithms. Finally, edge computing was tested for real-time deployment, making these predictions within a second and maintenance interventions prompt. It is shown that the hybrid CNN-LSTM model drastically improves PdM accuracy over other models, thereby reducing downtime and maintenance costs. It is a promising solution for promoting predictive maintenance in industrial cases, based on the scalability and robustness of this approach. Finally, future work will understand data quality challenges and more advanced methods, such as reinforcement learning and digital twins, to further improve model performance.

articleTitle: Real-Time Sentiment Analytics: Integrating NLP for Social Media Insight
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: The social networking sites of Instagram, WhatsApp, Twitter, and YouTube have led to this tremendous volume of user-generated content in text, images, and videos. Now all these elements-from marketing to direct customer engagement-become contingent upon the analysis of the emotional context of such multimodal data. This research strongly advocates an architecture that unifies NLP for text-based content and deep learning for the visual data into emotion categorization because traditional techniques for sentiment analysis cannot merge the two input modalities into meaningful and actionable insights. While EfficientNet covers the visual inputs such as images and video frames, GPT-2, optimized with LoRA, classifies the emotions within the text comments and captions. Some pipelines are included in the real-time processing modular architecture. The outputs are executed through a chatbot on an interactive frontend constructed with ReactJS. Other salient features include ensemble-based data fusion, improved pretreatment pipelines, and scalable back-end deployment. Results: This depicts a reasonably high accuracy and scale in different platforms. The overall multimodal framework would, therefore, allow organizations to extract maximum potential from the knowledge available on social media and thereby transform the process of emotion analytics.

articleTitle: Consumer Purchase Decision Making of Omni-Channel Market - A Study with Special Reference to Chennai City
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Background: Consumer shopping behaviour has changed noticeably as omni-channel retailing—especially in cities like Chennai—has proliferated. In this sense, stores must be rather clear about the factors affecting consumers' purchase decisions. Research Problem: Although omni-channel strategies are becoming more and more important, not much research on consumer behaviour especially related to the dynamics of the Chennai market exists. It was decided on a mixed-method approach with a quantitative survey with one thousand respondents and three hundred consumer qualitative interviews. Factor analysis and regression analysis among other statistical approaches was used in data analysis. articleTitle: Tool Condition Prediction in High-Speed Milling Using Deep Q-Networks (DQN) and Sensor Fusion Data
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Highly effective and reliable high-speed milling depends on the timely tool condition monitoring (TCM) check. In this paper, we propose a novel approach for tool condition prediction based on DQN with sensor fusion data. Both contact and non-contact sensors such as, vibrational, force, and acoustic emission sensors are utilized to gather data in real time during milling. The information collected by these sensors are integrated into a number of important features to be used in DQN model to learn the prediction of tool wear and possible failure. The DQN model is built to learn from the response of the milling environment characterized by tool condition in terms of wear and the remaining useful life (RUL). The results derived from experiments tend to show that the utilised DQNbased model has better quantitative values for accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score than classical machine learning models like artificial neural networks (ANN), support vector regression (SVR), decision trees and etc. The integration of the sensor data enhances the overall prediction reliability, a factor which is highly achieved from the fusion of the data received from the vibration, force and acoustic emission sensors. The overall system proposed has significant application for real time implementation and demonstrates relatively short prediction time and is less sensitive to changes in the machining conditions. This proposed methodology is a feasible approach for improving tool life and reducing time needed for high speed milling applications.

articleTitle: Predicting Pest Infestation Patterns with Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN) in Precision Farming
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Due to the increases pest impacts on agricultural productivity, effective pest prediction models are required for efficient pest control in precision farming. The framework outlined in this research uses a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) to estimate pest infestation by exploiting spatial and temporal relationships present in agri-ecosystems. The methodology combines weather, soil, pest, and crop health data into a graph-based representation of spatial units, and the directed connections between them that reflect their proximity and climatic similarity. The GCN converts these graphs to learn such complex relationship as the infestation prediction at various severity levels. The proposed model has produced a better accuracy of 94.8%, better precision of 95.2%, better recall of 94.5% and better F1-score of 94.8% as compared from Random forest, SVM, LSTM, CNN as per the comparison of table 3. Comparing them focuses on graph construction approaches and temporal aspects, mixed P/S and temporal emb has improved the model performance. This framework is practical for further pest management and employing the result without harming the environment. The results show the effectiveness of GCNs for use in pest prediction in precision farming and the opportunity to develop sustainable and scalable data-based agriculture.

articleTitle: Big Data in Financial Markets: Advanced Risk Assessment and Fraud Detection Frameworks Using RNN
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: As the financial markets are constantly changing it is significant to emphasize the importance of the sophisticated risk evaluation and fraud identification systems. From these, the developed framework of this paper integrates big data analytics and machine learning algorithms to improve risk management and to provide real-time solutions for fraudulent activities. The research methodology uses Decision Trees, Random Forests, Support Vector Machines, Convolutional Neural Networks, and Recurrent Neural Networks in handling large volumes of financial data. The performance of these models in type of accurate, precise, recall and time complexity make it clear that deep learning models are a better option for detecting market risks and fraud compared to the traditional machine learning models though the former consumes more computational power than the latter. Moreover, the study discusses feature engineering as an essential step that greatly improves the model result due to merging extra economic factors and sentiment analysis. Web based data analysis takes advantage of the big data processing frameworks like Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark to perform structured and unstructured financial data analysis in real time. The findings reveal that although deep learning models give the better accurate outcomes the other models like Random Forests, Decision Trees yield a higher result in terms of speed used for real time applications. The findings of this work will be helpful in enhancing the fundamental evaluation of numerous confirmed and prospective frauds in the financial industry to help avoid further attacks, plus augment the existing systems for risk assessment to offer superior protection against such illicit activities.

articleTitle: Medical Image Denoising using Deep Convolutional Autoencoders for Ultrasound
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: This paper describes a new strategy for medical image deaning based on the Deep Convolutional Autoencoders (DCAE) with focus on ultrasound modality. There are several types of noise including speckle, Gaussian and salt-and-pepper noise, which interfere with the ultrasound image and complicate the diagnostic interpretation of the image. To this end, the authors suggest a model that utilizes DCAE and deep learning to demine noise while maintaining the structural features required for diagnosis. Gaussian and median filtering, which are the typical filters for denoising, are used as benchmarks for comparison; the current state-of-the-art deep learning models are also included in the comparison list. This reveals that the proposed DCAE has better performance than these methods through higher PSNR, SSIM, and lower MSE. Also, the comparative analysis of customers subjective perception of the image quality has revealed that the denoised images created with the help of the DCAE have better visualization. This successfully establishes a suitable performance when the model is faced with various forms of noise across ultrasound imaging conditions as evidenced in the model presented above. In addition, owing to its ability to achieve fast-inference time and flexibility in terms of deployment, the model can be implemented for real-time clinical use. In conclusion, the utilization of DCAE-based approach considered in the current paper can be viewed as a viable method that can be used in the further enhancement of the quality of the ultrasound images together with the potential for increasing the levels of diagnostic accuracy as well as delivering better quality of care to patients in their recovery process within medical practice.

articleTitle: Real-Time Monitoring of Structural Health with Wireless Sensor Networks in IoT Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks for structural health monitoring of infrastructure are now becoming an IoT. It provides the ability to collect and analyze survivability data in real-time to enable continuous structural health monitoring for buildings, bridges, and other critical infrastructure. The purpose of this abstract is to introduce Real-time Monitoring with Wireless Sensor Networks in IoT Infrastructure. Wireless Sensor Networks are used in structural health monitoring. They are typically composed of many distributed, cheap sensors embedded in the structure that communicate wirelessly to a central monitoring station. Those sensors, including temperature, strain and vibration, are critical in detecting potential structural problems. This data gets transmitted to a cloud for processing, which provides indications of an unusual characteristic or predictive failure. Compared to the traditional methods, there are several advantages of applying WSN for real-time structural health monitoring. Lead leads provide real-time updates on the condition of a bridge that allows for continuous monitoring, with advanced sensors pinpointed through its structure. It will assist in keeping the infrastructure safe and affordable by guaranteeing rapid time-to-resolution. In addition, WSNs have low implementation costs and do not interfere too much with the structure of large structures.

articleTitle: Big Data Solutions for Predictive Healthcare Analytics: Enhancing Patient Outcomes and Operational Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: The embracing of Big Data solutions in healthcare comes with widely prospect to enhance patient satisfaction and increase organizational effectiveness. The research aims to use Predictive techniques and models coupled with modern data integration systems to improve the health care services. The components of the suggested methodology are deep neural networks for patient monitoring and prognosis, wearable devices, and operational prognosis models for resources use. From the practice of this approach, we have noticed marked increase in the patient monitoring frequency, efficiency of timely intervention, and generalization of health care organization productivity factors such as wait time and other resource utilization. In addition, the Onshape plan carried measurable benefits for the patient results such as satisfaction, reduced mortality, improved chronic disease, and the lesser hospital readmission. The results emphasize that the opportunities that Big Data and predictive analytics offer for healthcare can be indeed immense - offering improved care and more effective outcomes at a lower total cost. This research focuses on how Big Data solutions can help create a better future of healthcare improving the clinical and operational activities in this sphere and, thus, the population's health.

articleTitle: Opportunistic Spectrum Access Techniques for Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Opportunistic spectrum access (OSA) strategies have emerged as a promising option to cope with the increasing demand for spectrum resources in cognitive radio networks. Those networks are designed to allow secondary users (SUs) to opportunistically utilize underutilized licensed spectrum bands without causing harmful interference to number-one customers (PUs). OSA strategies utilize spectrum sensing, spectrum selection, and spectrum sharing techniques to efficiently and correctly allocate spectrum resources to SUs. The main goal of these techniques is to maximize spectrum usage while ensuring the safety of licensed customers. Spectrum sensing strategies allow SUs to discover spectrum holes, and secondary customers can opportunistically transmit them in those idle spectrum bands. Spectrum selection techniques help SUs determine the first-rate spectrum bands to utilize based totally on diverse metrics along with channel satisfaction, interference, and sign strength. Spectrum-sharing techniques enable SUs to allocate spectrum resources among multiple users dynamically. These techniques can noticeably improve spectrum usage and alleviate the issue of spectrum shortage in cognitive radio networks, which is mainly due to advanced device performance and enhanced user revel.

articleTitle: A Green and Secure Model for Fog Computing in Mobile Cloud Environments Using Containerization
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Internet of Things devices, and mobile computing, there is a growing demand for effective data processing where computation meets network traffic. Here, the fog computing concept has emerged to cater to this demand through a decentralized architecture that allows the processing and storing of data closer to end-users. Despite this, the dynamic and diverse fog computing ecosystem delivers security threats and resource efficiency challenges. This article introduces a solution for it, called the Green and Secure Model for Fog Computing in Mobile Cloud Environments, by implementing container architecture. Containers allow applications with dependencies to be bundled together for improved portability, scalability, and resource utilization models such as GSM-FCMCE. Moreover, the model contains an intelligent security layer where encryption and data- authentication and access control paradigms-help protect volatile information from malicious attacks. In addition, the proposed model adopts green computing techniques to minimize energy utilization and increase sustainability in fog-based environments. By performing many experiments and simulations, the efficiency in terms of security achieved based on the GSM-FCMCE model works to minimize energy waste rate and increase resource utilization. It would seem quite a viable model for the cloud computing community to solve some of these fog-related issues and introduce more sustainable & secure mobile data processing.

articleTitle: An Improved Digital Signal Processing for Signal Enhancement and Interference Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Digital Signal Processing has become a fundamental tool in signal processing applications, such as speech and image processing, due to its ability to manipulate and examine signals in a digital form skillfully. A primary challenge in signal processing involves the presence of unwanted noise and interference, which can negatively impact the precision and quality of the processed signal. The proposed advanced DSP approach aims to improve signal enhancement and interference mitigation techniques using sophisticated algorithms and methods. The proposed state-of-the-art DSP approach includes noise reduction algorithms, such as adaptive filtering and spectral subtraction, to eliminate unwanted noise from the signal. Additionally, cutting-edge signal processing techniques, such as wavelet transforms and time-frequency analysis, are used for signal enhancement and demising. The proposed approach employs adaptive equalization techniques to mitigate interference from other signals and substantially improve the overall signal quality. The enhanced DSP approach is evaluated through simulation and real-world experiments, demonstrating its effectiveness in improving signal quality and reducing interference considerably. The proposed approach has the potential to significantly improve the accuracy and reliability of various signal processing applications considerably, making it a valuable tool in fields such as telecommunications, audio and video processing, and medical signal analysis.

articleTitle: Optimizing CNN Architectures for Early Detection of Lung Cancer Using CT Images
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Lung cancer remains a primary cause of cancer-related deaths globally, and early diagnosis is crucial to improve patient outcomes. Whole-body computed tomography (CT) imaging holds promise as a diagnostic tool for the early detection of lung cancer. Still, malignancies' highly variable and spatially complex properties require refined image analysis techniques. Although convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have become great tools for image analysis, performance relies highly on network architecture design. articleTitle: Advanced Bone Fracture Detection Using Hybrid Deep Learning Algorithms and Machine Learning Models for Enhanced Medical Imaging Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Bone fractures belong to the group of the most frequent pathologies in medical practice and proper diagnosis is crucial for receiving an adequate treatment and recovery. This paper describes the next generation work in the medical imaging diagnostics, advancing the bone fracture detection system based on hybrid Deep Learning and Machine Learning technologies applied on X-ray images. The proposed system was tested using 10,000 X-ray images which include normal, fracture scaphoid, fracture clavicle, fracture humerus, fracture radius/ulna, fracture tibia/fibula, fracture femur, fracture pelvic, fracture spine/vertebra, fracture ankle, fracture knee, fracture jaw images which are annotated in our dataset. The way we take the approach is using transfer learning with pre trained convolutional neural networks (CNN) like ResNet50 and DenseNet121 for robust feature extraction and then using traditional machine learning algorithms such as Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Random Forest for classification. Class imbalance was reduced by using techniques in data augmentation and model generalization was enhanced to identify fine fractures that would otherwise be unnoticed. They were meticulously tested with conventional evaluation parameters such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, demonstrated better performance than traditional diagnosis. In normal fracture bone images the hybrid system is found to be 96.5% accurate in terms of identification.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Melanoma Detection: A CNN and RNN Hybrid Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Deep learning networks have recently performed excellently in medical image analysis tasks, including skin cancer detection [5]. Many works have proposed using a hybrid deep learning approach that combines Convolutional Neural Networks and Recurrent Neural Networks for accurate classification to detect lethal forms of skin cancer melanoma [17]. Our proposed method combines the advantages of CNN in image feature extraction and RNN in dealing with sequential data. To establish a comprehensive CNN-RNN hybrid model, we train on more skin images, and the model can separate [separate] between benign or malignant lesions. CNN captures the low-level image features, and RNN helps to analyze the sequential pattern of these features, thereby enhancing detection accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed hybrid approach can achieve better accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity than traditional CNN-only models. Furthermore, the model proposed may also use patient-specific information such as demographics and medical history for better detection performance. The deep learning strategy can allow earlier melanoma diagnosis and help save patient lives.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Models for Predictive Stability in Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: The usage of renewable energy sources is changing the distribution of energy. This makes customers both energy users and producers, which means that energy flows both ways in smart grids. In this complicated system, keeping the balance between supply and demand in check is necessary for keeping the grid safe. Researchers are currently focusing on decentralized smart grid control (DSGC) systems that measure grid frequency, which is a key indicator of power balance, to get a real-time idea of how stable the system is. Using math equations, the DSGC model predicts grid stability in a simple 4node star structure. That being said, this model is too simple and needs more complex approaches. To make a better analysis, this study uses deep learning methods, such as Keras' sequential model. For prediction purposes, the model includes 60,000 examples and 12 predictive features. These include reaction time, nominal power, and price elasticity. Cross-validation can be used to create an artificial neural network (ANN) with three hidden layers after scaling. When it came to predicting grid safety, this model had an accuracy of 97.73% compared to simpler models.

Author Keywords: Deep Learning model and Stability system

articleTitle: A Study on Impact of Social Media Marketing on Flats Purchase Decision of Consumers with Respect to Real Estate in Puducherry UT
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Background: For marketing in many various fields, including real estate, social media is today a really powerful tool. This article looks at how social media marketing influences consumer flat purchase decisions in the Union Territory of Puducherry, India. Consumers' impressions of and interactions with real estate items have evolved as digital platforms have exponential proliferation. This shift has underscored the significance of knowing how social media impacts consumers' decision-making process, particularly in regard to house purchase. Problem Statement: This study intends to address the lack of understanding of how multiple social media channels-Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp-affect consumer behaviour in the real estate market in Puducherry. Given this knowledge gap, real estate marketers find it challenging to utilise their digital strategies to correctly target probable consumers. Findings: The paper 250 Puducherry residents who just bought homes or are considering doing so answered a survey using a mixed-methods approach-that is, combining qualitative and quantitative research techniques. The survey data were investigated using statistical tools including chisquare testing and regression analysis in order to find the link between consumer purchase decisions and social media marketing traits (including engagement, content quality, and frequency of exposure). Moreover, thorough interviews with twenty individuals produced qualitative knowledge of how successful social media marketing is perceived by them. Participation in social media and the possibility of purchasing an apartment show a clear favourable correlation (r = 0.67, p = 0.01). Consumers exposed to premium content (mean rating = 4.3 on a 5-point scale) and consistent social media marketing were 35% more likely to decide what to buy. Furthermore, 62% of the respondents said that social media greatly influenced the real estate brand they choose.

articleTitle: Smart Transportation Systems: The Role of IoT and Sensor-Based Solutions
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Smart transportation systems are sophisticated technology solutions that deploy the Internet of Things (IoT) and sensor-based data platforms to transform one's existing erratic transportation network into an efficient system. The Internet of Things, which combines all devices and systems connected to the Internet, is changing our management and operation of transportation systems. Real-time data from sensors installed on vehicles, infrastructure, and other transport assets is one of the biggest benefits IoT can offer to transportation. This data will reduce traffic congestion, improve road safety, and help buses move smoothly in terms of traffic flow. A good way of illustrating this is through sensors equipped with traffic lights that communicate to the cars, where they can adjust between red and green light times while in action, thus causing fewer accidents on the road. loT likewise can lessen energy consumption and emissions, driving by way of the sustainability lens on transportation systems. Smart traffic management systems can adjust routes for vehicles, saving fuel and emissions. Cars and even electric vehicles can be configured using the same platform through this system will deliver higher efficiency for managing charging stations. Additionally, IoT and sensor integration are important for the growth of autonomous vehicles. These vehicles need immediate input from cameras, radars, and LiDARs to move around safely. IoT will allow these vehicles to communicate, and the transportation infrastructure will lead to a safer means of transport.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Forecasting of Solar Photovoltaic Generation for Microgrid Control
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Deep Learning-Based Forecasting of Solar Photovoltaic Generation for Micro grid Control is a new approach to accurately predicting solar photovoltaic generation in micro grids. These feature renewable energy such as Solar PV and are a responsive approach for providing efficient, sustainable power solutions. In contrast, solar PV power production is not dispatch able because it depends on the changing weather and other factors. The new method applies deep learning algorithms, mainly artificial neural networks, to historical data to accurately forecast solar PV output. The latter sorts the variation due to a broad array of meteorological and operational parameters, including temperature, humidity level, cloud cover, and shading Moreover, the model can forecast results online and keep learning with new data for real-time micro grid control. The deep learning-based method has shown superior performance to traditional forecasting methods in improving the precision of PV generation forecasts. Benefits include more efficient energy management, better integrating renewable sources into the micro grid, and lower costs. This means that the Deep Learning-Based Forecasting of Solar Photovoltaic Generation for Micro grid Control could significantly improve the reliability and efficiency of micro grid operations and promote a more sustainable and resilient energy system.

articleTitle: Hybrid Optimization Algorithms for Accurate Prediction and Classification of Cardiovascular Diseases
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: A collection of precise prediction models is necessary to lessen the burden of cardiovascular disease (CVD), which continues to be a leading cause of death worldwide. This work presents a unique hybrid optimization approach for improving the categorization and prediction of cardiac disease. Support Vector Machine (SVM), Salp Swarm Optimized Neural Network (SSO-NN), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), Bayesian Optimization of SVM (BO-SVM), and by combining PSO and gradient descent (PSOGD) are some of the advanced machine learning algorithms that have been implemented with improved accuracy. Training, testing, and validation are done using the Cleveland and Framingham datasets. Imputation for missing data and feature scaling using MinMaxScaler are important preprocessing processes. In order to evaluate performance parameters like as sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy. As a consequence, the hybrid PSOGD algorithm achieved impressive results, with accuracies with the dataset of Cleveland having 99.56% and other dataset Framingham having 98.80%. The model's robustness was shown by the sensitivity and specificity results. The measures like Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Squared Error (MSE), and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) over epochs, the performance analysis is further testified to for model validation. It suggests that hybrid optimization algorithms that improve CVD prediction models be praised as essential for management planning and early identification. By exposing scalable alternatives for heart disease prediction, our study offers crucial help in the area where AI and health intersect.

articleTitle: Meta-Heuristic Approaches to Parallel Processing in Signal Representation and Real-Time Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Meta-heuristic techniques have been popular in solving highly complex optimization problems. Parallel processing is very important in signal representation and real-time analysis, as it helps lower the time required for the data process so that algorithms can perform faster. The biggest challenge with the traditional parallel processing techniques is load balancing and higher communication overhead, which may need to scale up to a larger extent. Meta-heuristic techniques reduce the complexity of problems that are NP-complete or NP-hard by providing satisfactory solutions and approximate answers to difficult ones. This has helped in parallel processing for signal representation and real-time analysis. Parallel processing has also been useful in using meta-heuristic algorithms like genetic algorithms, ant colony optimization, and particle swarm optimization. Meta-heuristic algorithms produce flexible, adaptive mechanisms for solving complex problems.

articleTitle: Consumer Behavior and Satisfaction Rate in Social Media Purchasing Ads Using Radial Basis Function Networks (RBFNS) Based BAT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Companies who wish to enhance their marketing plans must first be quite conscious of consumer behaviour and satisfaction with social media campaigns allowing purchase capability. Many unstructured data generated by social media channels makes it challenging to find feasible application concepts. Usually, the conventional approaches do not sufficiently show the non-linear interactions between consumer reactions and advertisement effectiveness. While current machine learning methods such artificial neural networks (ANN) or Support Vector machines (SVM) can offer insights, they lack the optimising force required to properly fine-tune parameters. The forecasts of satisfaction rates thus differ from ideal. Better predictive accuracy is obtained in the technique by using a Bat Algorithm in concert with Radial Basis Function Networks (RBFNs). The Bat Algorithm maximises RBFN parameters, which include weights, spread, and centers, so improving their performance. Ten thousand consumer records from social media buying campaigns made up the data used for the study. Among the data were click-through rates and degrees of satisfaction. For model validation as well as training, an 80–20 split was used. Predicting consumer satisfaction with a 96.2% accuracy, the RBFN-Bat model outperformed already in use approaches including artificial neural networks (92.5%) and support vector machines (89.7%). Moreover, the mean absolute error (MAE) dropped to 0.045 and the computational efficiency rose by 18% in comparison to earlier applied techniques.

articleTitle: Using IoT and Sensor Technology for Precision Agriculture: Opportunities and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Precision agriculture's purpose is to increase crop yield and reduce wastage at different optimization levels during farming practices. It provides farmers with detailed information about their crops, soil and weather conditions, enabling them to make better decisions on resource allocation. It has also changed the game by collating data from soil moisture sensors, weather stations and crop yield monitors and processing this massive amount of data to bring some meaning that does justice to its promise. Armed with this data, farmers can examine it and identify precise areas of their farms that require more or less water, fertilizer, or pesticides. Triangles like that can mean more bang for your buck translation: fewer chemicals, greater produce and smaller footprint. Some challenges need to be addressed before this technology can be successfully adopted. Notably, high installation and maintenance costs of sensors, Poor availability of broadband for remote or rural areas, and Data privacy & security concerns. The use of IoT and sensor technology is an interesting opportunity for farmers to increase efficiency as well as productivity in the process of precision agriculture.

articleTitle: Big Data for Enhancing Cybersecurity in Enterprise Environments Proactive Threat Detection and Prevention
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: This research explores the integration of big data technologies and machine learning to enhance cybersecurity in enterprise environments focusing on proactive threat detection and prevention. Traditional security systems often struggle to keep up with the growing complexity and volume of cyber threats, necessitating a more advanced, data-driven approach. The proposed methodology leverages real-time data processing, predictive modeling, and anomaly detection to improve threat detection accuracy, reduce response times, and enhance system scalability. By collecting and analyzing data from various network sources, including logs from security devices and endpoint protection software, the system detects potential threats more efficiently than conventional methods. Machine learning algorithms such as supervised and unsupervised learning, along with big data platforms like Apache Spark, enable real-time analysis of large volumes of data, ensuring timely identification of both known and unknown cyber threats. The results demonstrate significant improvements in detection accuracy, system scalability, and incident resolution time, with the proposed methodology outperforming traditional security systems in key performance metrics. This research highlights the potential of big data-driven cybersecurity solutions in addressing modern challenges and offers a framework for organizations to implement more effective, scalable, and proactive security measures to safeguard their digital assets.

articleTitle: Soil Moisture Prediction with Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN) for Precision Irrigation
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Soil moisture forecast is of great importance for precision irrigation, which stretches water resources, thus encouraging conservation among farmers. On this premise, this study puts forth a model based on a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) for enhanced soil moisture forecasting. TCNs are selected for their natural approach of modeling long term temporal dependencies in the temporal data that is crucial to model change in soil moisture level due to changes in weather conditions and type of soil. The model then uses info from the soil moisture sensors, the weather forecast and remote sensing of the land surface. Data pre-processing steps such as, data cleansing, data interpolation, and data normalization makes the raw data fit for modeling. The TCN is then compared with RF and SVM, two other ML models achieving better accuracy, although with comparatively low MAE and RMSE values. This model is trained on the history data and evaluated through cross-validation in order of selecting the hyperparameters of the number of layer, and the rate of dilation of layers. Real-time prediction is done for automatic irrigation systems and afterwards irrigation decisions may be taken based on the soil moisture predicted by the model. The identified system reveals potential for increasing the utilization of water and crop yields and hence promoting sustainable and resource-optimizing farming systems.

articleTitle: Scalable Cloud-Based Platforms For IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: The several possible applications and advantages the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) offers help to explain the present explosive popularity it generates. Here among many other fields, including business, healthcare, automation, and built environment, this is especially true. Among the most important factors driving the IIoT's recent growing popularity is One of the various reasons the Internet of Things (IoT) has lately drawn a lot of interest is Though it offers a broad range of conceivable applications, the Internet of Things raises significant security problems. A heterogeneous environment follows when devices in an Internet of Things network could interact with one another. This environment makes it challenging to build consistent security methods all throughout the network. Three main areas where the security of the internet of things excel are limited access, data confidentiality, and data authentication. Although these measures are aimed to protect user data, Internet of Things security still has to be filled in-between. Therefore, the security of the IIoT network rests entirely on the availability of a separate module. More usually known as IDSs, intrusion detection systems have been increasingly deployed in wireless networks in recent years. By means of improved wireless cloud-based intrusion detection systems (CIDS), the Internet of Things (IoT) will provide better protection of networks from vulnerabilities. In this work, we construct a CIDS model employing three machine learning methods as the basic classifier for the model. Application of a voting classifier results in the best classification performance in the end. The results help to determine the resistance of the model to various kinds of attacks, therefore guiding its strength. The results reveal that the rate of detection accuracy surpasses that of other approaches.

articleTitle: The Role of AI in Shaping HRM Skills and Strategies in Private Banks: A Study on Manager-Employee Dynamics in Chennai City
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Background: In the private banking industry, including artificial intelligence (AI) into human resource management (HRM) has completely transformed workforce management. Fast acceptance of digital technologies has driven financial institutions to use artificial intelligence (AI) to improve recruitment, employee training, performance review, and workplace efficiency. With an eye towards the changing dynamics between managers and employees, this paper attempts to investigate how artificial intelligence has impacted human resource management skills and strategies in private banks housed inside Chennai City. Objectives: The study identifies the main barriers related to the acceptance of artificial intelligence. Among these challenges are ethical concerns about data privacy, technological knowledge gaps among HR managers, and change resistance. Data Collection: Data were collected using a mixed-methods approach from 250 employees hired for ten different private banks in Chennai and 120 managers. These banks call Chennai their hometown. We obtained both quantitative and qualitative knowledge of the impact artificial intelligence has in redefining HR practices by means of a survey and semi-structured interviews. Findings: According to the results, many managers-more especially, those in the field of predictive analytics for employee performance-acknowledge artificial intelligence as a required tool for decision-making. Seventy-five percent of employees have reported an increase in their degree of satisfaction with their company thanks to customised training programs driven by artificial intelligence and better strategies for preserving a good work-life balance. Still, 68% of respondents voiced concerns regarding the possibility that artificial intelligence would replace human contacts in HRM systems.

articleTitle: Hybrid Optical-Electrical Transceiver Architecture for High-Speed Data Communications
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Evaluating Design Tradeoffs in MMW Wave Arrays for High-Speed Wireless Data Communication and its Optimization over Fiber If you tear open your cloud, you will find a stream of is and Os at the heart of all this, with shrill screams from demanding applications like video, virtual reality, etc. pushing I believe close to their limits bandwidth comments here up purely optical links. We are reporting on highresolution computational imaging optimized for 3D surface reconstruction with tight constraints on operational uncertainty. Traditional electronic-only transceiver architecture is approaching its physical limits regarding data speed and power efficiency spurring the critical demand for more advanced approaches. Novel hybrid optical-electrical transceiver architecture has been discussed to overcome these limitations. It blends the fast speeds and broad bandwidths made possible by optical communication with the flexibility and scale of electrical circuits. The heart of this architecture is an electro-optic interface that converts electrical signals to optical. Enabling this interface is advanced materials like silicon photonics that permit optical and electronic components to be integrated into a single chip. This hybrid architecture combines optical communication for high-speed data transmission and enables data rates that are multiple orders of magnitude faster than traditional electronic-only architectures. Moreover, optical interconnects directly benefit the transceiver by lowering its power consumption, reducing total energy use and improving system performance.

articleTitle: Smart Sports: Enhancing Physical Performance with IoT and Sensor Technologies
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Smart Sports is a pioneering one that employs the Internet of Things (IoT) and sensor technology in optimizing physical performance for sports. Using connected wearables, equipment, and facilities, SmartPitch can collect real-time data for analyses that help improve training techniques and preinjury precautionary methods, leading to improved performance. Smart Sports gives a more complete look at an athlete's performance as the global application of IoT and sensor technology in sports continues to increase. Wearable technology, such as smart clothing, fitness bands, or GPS trackers, is capable of monitoring vital signs and physical information in real-time to assist coaches in analyzing everything relevant to an athlete. Smart Sports applications also include smart equipment and venues like Smart Home Courts or Pitches that are equipped with ball speed, trajectory & impact sensors to deliver instant quantitative feedback to coaches on player technique & performance. The information could be built upon to design a bespoke training program to suit that individual, providing an efficient and potentially very effective product. While the technology can improve player performance, Smart Sports are also used to predict injuries before they happen and give athletes or their coaches a headsup in real-time. IoT has the potential to ensure safer training, thus increasing an athlete's career longevity and quality of life. In general, smart sports can provide a data-driven and customized way to improve physical capacity, prevent injuries, and increase the chances of sporting success.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Banking: Regression Analysis for Credit Risk Prediction
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: one of the areas where Artificial Intelligence (AI) has made a significant impact is when it comes to how banks quantify and predict credit risk. One of the most commonly used AI techniques is Regression Analysis, in which the default probability for a potential borrower is expected with the help of historical data. In bank and financial services, Regression Analysis includes building a statistical model that establishes a relationship between the credit risk factors like income, credit score, and credibility ratio concerning the probability of default. New data is also used to continually train and retrain the model, optimizing its risk prediction. Using Regression Analysis for credit risk prediction in banking has several benefits. It enables banks to make better credit decisions, thus reducing defaults and improving profitability. AI also accelerates credit risk assessment, saving banks resources and time. In addition, using AI systems enables a rapid response to economic changes and changes in customer composition, so banks can ensure that their credit risk analysis is adequate and, as the case may be, real-time. Ultimately, that tech enables banks to put their resources where they do more good and run a tighter overall ship.

articleTitle: IoT in Smart Homes: Enhancing Lifestyle Through Intelligent Automation and Control
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) functionality integrated into smart homes has transformed residents' ways of engaging with homes, from comfort, security, and energy saving aspects. This study aims at understanding the role played by IoT based smart automation and control in enhancing people's living standards within homes. Smart homes are designed utilizing applications that centralize the control of other smart devices like smart manage thermostat, smart lighting, home security cameras and smart voice assistant. These systems allow people to automate jobs, conserve and manage energy, and design environments to people's specific needs. Moreover, the study investigates threat mechanisms of IoT in smart home with respect to data privacy issues as well as the weaknesses of devices and the possibility of cyber threats. One of the major considerations of this work is focused on ways through which IoT systems can be designed to learn about users and their requirements as well as make decisions on their own using machine learning techniques. Thus, the study shows that through IoT technology not only by providing convenience and energy-saving opportunities, but also giving homeowners control to create and establish safer and more comfortable home environment. In this research, recommendations are made for the need to bring improvement on the reliability, security, and accessibility of IoT in home automation market it has made.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Supply Chain and User-Centric Service Oriented Framework for Healthcare 5.0
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: The medicine Supply Chain System (SCS) is an efficient functional network around the essential enterprise. A robust medicine SCS has become essential in the post-COVID era to ensure timely access to life-saving medications, facilitate efficient distribution of vaccines, prevent shortages, and ensure resilience during health crises. Corruption, fraud, and manipulation are all potential threats to a supply chain that is managed centrally. The pharmaceutical supply chain can be more secure and transparent by utilizing the different inbuilt cryptographic algorithms, smart contracts, and consensus mechanisms. This technology also provides a secure way of data sharing, and autonomous management as a distributed ledger. The integration of blockchain technology into supply chain management, or SCM, is examined in this study in order to develop a system architecture that is trustworthy, transparent, authentic, and safe. In addition to specific algorithms outlining the operation of our proposed solution, we also provide system architecture. We also concentrate on applying blockchain technology to solve the problem of hierarchical transactions.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Low-Power Body Area Network for Real-Time Monitoring of Vital Signs
publicationTitle: 2025 International Conference on Automation and Computation (AUTOCOM)
abstract: Body area network refers to wearable sensors that can measure vital signs 24/7. It has potential uses in healthcare, such as early detection of health issues. The more difficult part about implementing a BAN is creating a system that uses low power and will need to be replaced over long periods. In this work, we present the design and implementation of a low-power BAN for real-time acquisition of vital signals. It comprises small, energy-efficient sensors that measure vital signs like heart rate, blood pressure and body temperature. Each sensor is interfaced to a low-power radio module that transmits the data wirelessly to a central monitoring unit. Then, we use novel energy-management strategies like duty cycling and dynamic voltage scaling to save power consumption. We are also using sophisticated signal processing algorithms to minimize the data that needs to be sent, which will also help to decrease power consumption. We have successfully deployed and tested a BAN in real conditions. Our results demonstrate major savings in battery consumption over current implementations of BAN. This low-power BAN can change the healthcare field and accelerate its deployment by allowing vital signs to be monitored in real-time at an affordable cost.
